description:
What Makes Us Stand Out:

Granum is the leading software company devoted to serving landscapers and arborists across North America, providing intuitive, industry-specific solutions designed to help them improve and grow their businesses while impressing their customers. Granum brings together three of the most trusted software names in the industry — LMN, SingleOps, and Greenius — into one powerful software ecosystem. More than just a software company, Granum works alongside its clients to implement systems for estimating, scheduling, crew training, invoicing, and payments, blending technology with hands-on onboarding and human support. The company's mission is to help industry professionals unlock their potential and achieve their most important goals, all united by the belief that its clients’ success is not just a milestone, but a shared mission.

As a team, we’re on a mission to reshape an age-old industry, and we’re looking for people who thrive on challenging and meaningful work. Our environment is highly collaborative, innovative, and supportive, with a shared commitment to having fun while making an impact. We live by our core values: We Before Me, Bias to Act, The Extra 1%, Accountable to Outcomes, Unconditional Transparency, and Forgiveness. If this resonates with you, we’d love to meet you and explore how you can help us build the future of the green industry!

Our culture and growth has been recognized with multiple awards, it’s a great time to join!

  • Comparably 2024 #23/100 Best (small/ medium sized companies) Leadership Teams
  • Comparably 2024 #63/75 (small/ medium sized companies) Happiest Employees
  • #9 Atlanta Business Chronicle's 2024 Best Places to Work (Our second year in a row!)
  • #6 of Built In’s 2024 Best Places to Work: Top 50 start-ups in Atlanta (Our second year in a row!)
  • Inc Magazine’s 2023 Best Places to Work
  • Inc. 5000: #131 of 2024 Southeast Regional America’s Fastest Growing Companies. (Our third year in a row!)
  • Inc 5000 America's fastest-growing private companies (Our third year in a row!)
  • Certified Great Place to Work Canada 2024

Role summary
We’re hiring a Senior Data Engineer to help treat data as a product at Granum. This role is responsible for building and operating trusted data products, governed datasets, and durable platform workflows that power
analytics, AI, and operational decision-making across the company. You’ll help make data easier to trust, use, and scale by improving the systems, guardrails, and platform patterns that turn raw data into reliable products for teams across Granum.

How we work
We expect engineers on this team to own outcomes end to end. That means identifying gaps early, driving decisions, communicating clearly, and delivering complete solutions rather than stopping at partial implementation.
We value simple, durable platform patterns over unnecessary complexity. We use automation aggressively to reduce repetitive work, improve consistency, and increase team leverage.

Agentic development is a team expectation. This role is expected to adopt and contribute to agentic workflows as part of standard engineering practice.

What you’ll own
• Build and maintain trusted internal data products that support analytics, AI, and operational workflows across Granum
• Design and operate scalable data pipelines and platform workflows using Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Terraform, and related tooling
• Improve data quality, validation, observability, and recoverability across critical datasets and workflows
• Own semantic consistency across upstream models, downstream consumption layers, and governed business definitions
• Design and implement governance controls including permissions, masking, privacy-aware access patterns, and durable operational guardrails
• Partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous data needs into reliable internal platform capabilities
• Drive platform improvements proactively, including better automation, cleaner workflow design, and stronger operating patterns across the team
• Contribute technical direction for internal data platform work and help raise the quality bar for how the team builds and operates data systems

Required qualifications:
• Strong experience building and operating data platforms in Snowflake-centric environments
• Strong experience with dbt or a comparable transformation framework
• Hands-on experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling to manage platform infrastructure, permissions, and operational controls
• Hands-on experience with a governed semantic or BI modeling layer (Omni, LookML, dbt Semantic
Layer, or similar)
• Experience designing reliable workflows for ingestion, transformation, validation, and scheduled operational processes, including CI/CD in GitHub.
• Strong SQL skills and a track record of building trusted datasets for business and technical consumers
• Demonstrated ownership of production-grade data systems, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident follow-through
• Ability to communicate clearly, drive decisions, and take ambiguous work through to a complete outcome
• Willingness and ability to work within a team where agentic development is an expected part of how engineering work gets done

Nice to have:
• Experience with orchestration tools or pipeline frameworks such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, or similar
• Experience with BI and semantic-layer tools such as Omni or similar governed analytics platforms
• Experience supporting AI-enabled workflows, internal tooling, or knowledge-driven applications
• Experience with privacy, access control, and governance patterns in modern cloud data platforms
• Experience working across multiple data domains or products with shared platform standards

Compensation:

  • Estimated pay range for Canada-based candidates: CAD 170,000 - 190,000

  • Estimated pay range for US-based candidates: USD 180,000-200,000

Reasons why you would love it here!

  • Join a team culture that’s all about collaboration, support, and having fun while making a real impact every day.
  • In the U.S., we offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options, plus additional add ons like HSA/FSA accounts, disability and life insurance, and more.
  • In Canada, we provide an employer-funded HSA-based benefits plan with drug, dental, and mental health coverage - giving you a flexible way to manage your healthcare needs.
  • We're committed to your financial future, with 401(k) matching for U.S. employees and RRSP matching for those in Canada.
  • We invest in your growth through tailored career development conversations and support for tools, courses, and resources to help you thrive.
  • And when it comes to work-life balance? We offer unlimited Paid Time Off, paid company holidays, and a company-wide winter break from December 24 to January 1 - so you can truly recharge.

title: Resource Development Intern
description:
VisionFund's work seeks to end intergenerational poverty through financial products and services. We're about the long-term change that ensures children can break free of the poverty cycle, for good.

By supporting people and communities living in poverty to develop and grow their livelihoods, VisionFund is catalysing sustainable economic growth to break the cycle of poverty, so that children can reach their potential as communities thrive.

Learn more about us:

Resource Development Intern

Remote within the US

World Vision Internships offer a three-month opportunity for talented students and recent graduates eager to dive into the international relief and development field. We are dedicated to giving you a meaningful learning experience, where you will grow, gain valuable skills, and connect with other passionate professionals who share our mission.

Internship Opportunity

VisionFund International (VFI) is the microfinance arm of World Vision, dedicated to providing credit, insurance, and savings services to underserved communities worldwide.

Join the Resource Development and Management team responsible for VisionFund's funding acquisition and management efforts. This internship will support the Resource Development & Management team in raising funding for VisionFund’s strategic vision and building a diversified future funding portfolio.

Our portfolio is focused on Institutional Grant funding from foundations, multilaterals, and government, and through Philanthropic Fundraising, working closely with both WV Support Office Teams and WV National Offices and VF MFI teams.

What You'll Do:

  • Grant Writing: Carry out research to underpin grant proposals, help with the writing and proofreading in the development of Institutional grant funding proposals with experienced grant writing professionals.

  • Funding Research: Carry out desk research and mapping on potential new institutional funders for VisionFund.

  • Support Reporting for FAST: Provide significant assistance in reporting on the FAST (Finance Accelerating Savings Group Transformation) program, which is a critical component of the World Vision International THRIVE 2030 Business Plan.

  • Contribute to the Goal of Serving 800,000 Members: Play a key role in helping the program meet its goal of serving 800,000 World Vision Savings Group members by 2030.

  • Assist in Data Collection and Analysis: Support efforts to deliver customized FAST reports for World Vision donors, including GSI mapping and impact stories.

  • Coordinate Across Teams: Work closely with field teams and global center staff to ensure seamless communication and accurate report creation.

  • Learn GIS Tools: If you are unfamiliar with GIS (Geographic Information Systems), we will provide training so you can effectively contribute to mapping and data analysis efforts.

  • Receive FAST Product Training: Get technical training on the FAST product to ensure you feel confident and well-equipped to support the program's objectives.

Why Join Us:

  • Gain Skills in ArcGIS: Learn to use ArcGIS for geospatial analysis and reporting, enhancing your technical and mapping skills.

  • Enhance Grant Writing Skills: Working with experienced grant writers, develop convincing proposal development skills

  • Enhance Donor Communication Experience: Contribute to donor communications, improving your ability to construct impactful reports and stories.

  • Develop Technical Understanding: Build your technical comprehension of how microfinance plays an important role in long-term community development and in disaster response.

  • Client Connection: Experience the real-world impact of your work by connecting with key client-facing staff in the field, ensuring you see the direct correlation between your efforts and the clients we serve.

  • Expand Your Horizons: Explore the international relief sector, unleash your leadership skills, and strengthen your Christian faith with Weekly Professional Development Sessions.

  • Transform Lives: Take on challenging and meaningful work assignments while developing your technical skills and gaining valuable hands-on experience.

  • Join an Inspiring Community: Form connections with a diverse nationwide intern cohort and colleagues who, inspired by their Christian faith, support children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong Writing Skills: Ability to communicate clearly and effectively through written reports, presentations, and donor communications.

  • Eagerness to Learn: A willingness and ability to quickly learn new skills, tools, and technologies, including GIS and the FAST product.

  • Curiosity: A genuine interest in exploring new ideas, problem-solving, and understanding how your work impacts the broader mission.

  • Cross-Cultural Communication: Ability to communicate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders across different cultures, time zones, and geographic locations.

  • Responsibility and Enthusiasm: You are responsible, responsive, and enthusiastic about using your God-given talents to positively influence the world.

  • Commitment to our Mission: You have a demonstrated commitment to and alignment with the goals, mission, and vision of World Vision, embodying its values in all aspects of your work.

What You Need to Know:

Details

  • Location: Remote within the US. You must be physically located in one of the following states where WVI is registered as an employer: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia (Washington D.C.), Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

  • Appropriate Fields of Study/Majors: International development, monitoring & evaluation, data collection and management, English, communications, economics, marketing, public policy, finance, nonprofit management, or related fields.

  • Internship Cohort Dates: 25 January – 23 April, 2027.

  • Stipend: This internship is unpaid, but all US-based interns receive a monthly stipend of $800.

  • Hours: Full-time and part-time opportunities are available (20-40 hours/week)

Eligibility

All candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • At least 18 years of age.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States (e.g., U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or F-1 student visa holder with valid work authorization) and possess a valid U.S. Social Security Number.

  • Able to commit to at least 20 hours per week for the entire internship period: 25 January – 23 April, 2027.

  • Current student or recent graduate from an undergraduate/graduate programme (within 2 years).

  • Adhere to World Vision International’s Christian Statement of Faith.

  • Willingness to use own electronic devices for internship purposes, and disposition to let WVI install endpoint security software in those devices.

Applicant Types Accepted:

Local Applicants Only

World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments.

title: PMO Project Manager
description:
Position Summary:


The Project Manager (PM) is a role within the Project Management Office (PMO), responsible for leading and delivering multiple concurrent projects and strategic initiatives across the organization. This role serves as a trusted partner to business leaders, executive sponsors, and cross-functional teams, ensuring projects are aligned with organizational priorities and deliver measurable business value.

The Project Manager owns all aspects of project delivery, from initiation through implementation and post-project closure, while providing leadership in project governance, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to manage competing priorities, and experience leading complex projects in a matrixed environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Leadership & Delivery
• Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple concurrent projects of varying size, complexity, and strategic importance.
• Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, resource plans, and deliverables.
• Establish clear project scope, objectives, success measures, and governance frameworks.
• Drive project execution while ensuring deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.
• Manage project interdependencies and proactively address barriers to successful delivery.

Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned projects and provide strategic guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
• Lead project meetings, steering committee sessions, workshops, and stakeholder reviews.
• Deliver clear and concise project updates, executive summaries, dashboards, and presentations to leadership.
• Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, risks, and outcomes.

PMO Process Support
• Ensure projects comply with PMO standards, methodologies, governance frameworks, and best practices.
• Participate in project intake, prioritization, and portfolio planning activities.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance PMO processes, tools, reporting, and project delivery capabilities.

Risk, Issue & Change Management
• Identify project risks and assist in developing mitigation strategies.
• Track and escalate issues as needed to project leadership.
• Support change request tracking and impact assessment.

Reporting & Performance Management
• Monitor project performance using KPIs, milestones, budgets, and success metrics.
• Prepare and deliver project and portfolio status reports for leadership and stakeholders.
• Track project benefits realization and measure achievement of business outcomes.
• Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support leadership decision-making.

Qualifications:

Required
• 8-12 years of progressive project management experience, including management of multiple concurrent projects.
• Demonstrated experience leading medium-to-large, cross-functional projects in complex organizational environments.
• Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches.
• Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across business and technical teams.
• Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and executive communication skills.

Preferred
• PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.
• Experience working within a PMO or enterprise portfolio management environment.
• Experience with project portfolio and work management tools such as Monday.com, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar platforms.
• Experience leading projects involving process improvement, technology implementations, organizational change, or operational transformation.

Core Competencies
• Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
• Problem-solving and critical thinking abilities
• Adaptability and willingness to learn
• Accountability and follow-through

title: Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
At

Siga leyendo para descubrir lo que necesitará para tener éxito en este puesto, incluyendo habilidades, cualificaciones y experiencia.

Indeep AI , we are an applied AI research laboratory working at the intersection of natural language processing, linguistics, and human cognition. Our work is grounded in a simple conviction: the tools we use to write and understand documents should make communication clearer and more trustworthy, not less. That research powers Typewiser, our document intelligence platform. Typewiser helps people produce and understand high-stakes documents with greater clarity and rigour, analysing how information is communicated, surfacing where meaning breaks down, and supporting the writer in real time. It is backed by European research funding and built on peer-reviewed scientific foundations. We are a small, multidisciplinary team of linguists, engineers, scientists, and operators. We are at the stage where the way we present ourselves to the world is still being built. That is where you come in.

We’re looking for a versatile

Full-Stack AI Engineer

to join our team at Indeep Artificial Intelligence (IAI) at

our office in Barcelona . We need someone who can support our technical efforts across the board. Working closely with and directly supporting our CTO, you will move fluidly across the whole stack — from backend and platform engineering, to the LLM and AI pipelines at the core of our product, to the infrastructure that runs it, to the frontend that users touch. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who is happiest when they can pick up almost any part of the system and make progress on it. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer. We need a strong generalist: someone who can context-switch, learn quickly, and be trusted to deliver across whatever the week demands. You won’t own the architecture, but you will be the person who helps turn it into working, reliable software, and your judgement will carry real weight.

We need someone with a strong startup attitude: sharp problem-solving skills, the ability to manage priorities and deliverables autonomously without rigid timeframes, and the capacity to handle diverse task assignments. If you thrive in ambiguity, move fast without sacrificing quality, and can pivot when priorities shift, you’re exactly who we’re looking for. This role is for someone energised by wearing multiple hats and making an impact without needing a detailed playbook. If that sounds like you, we’d be excited to hear from you.

Contract Type:

Permanent
Full Office-Based Work Modality:

Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00 at WeWork Glòries Barcelona

Duties & Responsibilities

Backend & Platform Engineering

Build, extend, and maintain the backend services and platform logic that power Typewiser.
Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and contribute to the overall health of the codebase.
Implement features end-to-end, from data layer through to API, in collaboration with the CTO.

LLM & AI Pipeline Work

Develop and integrate the LLM-driven pipelines at the core of the product, including prompting strategies, orchestration, structured outputs, and RAG and validation layers.
Integrate and evaluate third-party AI models and APIs, balancing quality, latency, and cost.
Help build the tooling and evaluation needed to keep AI-driven features reliable and reproducible.

Infrastructure & Deployment

Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.

Frontend & Full-Stack

Contribute to the frontend and deliver full-stack features as needed, ensuring a coherent experience from interface to backend.
Collaborate on the product’s UI where engineering and design meet.

Qualifications Required:

5 to 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python (our primary backend language).
Hands-on experience integrating and working with LLMs or other AI/ML models in production, including prompt engineering.
Working experience with frontend development and modern web frameworks.
Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
A genuine generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem across the entire stack rather than a single layer.
C1-level proficiency in English.
Ability to work in a fast-paced startup/scale-up environment and understand the specific challenges of early-stage companies.

Preferred:

Experience with AWS.
Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM evaluation.
Experience in an early-stage startup, owning broad surface area with limited support.
Exposure to NLP or document-processing systems.
Working proficiency in other EU languages, particularly Spanish and Italian.

What We Offer

€50,000–€80,000 yearly gross salary depending on demonstrable experience and breadth of skills.
A high-impact engineering role with broad ownership across the entire stack of a live AI product.
Close, direct collaboration with the CTO and visibility across the whole company.
Early-stage team member at a high-potential EIC-funded startup.

How to Apply

To apply, send your CV through LinkedIn along with links to work we can look at — a portfolio, GitHub, or projects you’ve shipped. We’re less interested in a cover letter than in seeing what you’ve actually built and how you approach problems across the stack. A short note on a project you’re proud of and your role in it is welcome. xkdbapo Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so don’t wait to apply.

title: Product Designer Mobile & Web | Remote
description:
Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.

We’re expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.

We’re looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude. You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you’ve been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.


The role


You’ll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You’ll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.

The role will include:

  • Product discovery and exploring new ideas
  • Turning early ideas into clear user journeys
  • Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems
  • Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs
  • Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing
  • Designing across iOS, Android and web
  • Working with and improving our design systems
  • Working closely with developers throughout implementation
  • Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users
  • Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business

There’s a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.


What matters to us


Attention to detail is a big one.

We need someone who naturally spots things that don’t quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.

We also want someone who can work independently. You won’t always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you’ll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.

You should be curious and proactive. Look at what other products are doing, bring new ideas to the team and be willing to challenge something if you think there’s a better way of doing it.

We’re a very collaborative team, so you need to be comfortable sharing your work, receiving feedback and changing direction when needed. We move quickly and priorities can change, so being flexible is important. Sometimes something else becomes more important and we all need to jump in and help.

We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership of their work. The job doesn’t finish when a design is handed over to development. We expect our designers to look at what has actually been built, use it and help make sure the final experience is right.


What we're looking for


  • Relevant experience as a Product / UX/UI Designer
  • A strong portfolio showing real digital products you’ve worked on
  • Experience designing for mobile and web
  • Good understanding of iOS and Android UX patterns
  • Experience with discovery, user flows and prototyping
  • Experience creating prototypes for interviews and user testing
  • Experience working with design systems
  • Comfortable working closely with developers
  • Able to work independently and take ownership of a piece of work
  • Very strong attention to detail
  • Curious, proactive and happy to bring ideas to the table
  • Comfortable working in a startup where things can move quickly
  • Fluent English, written and spoken


The setup


  • Remote
  • Contractor / PJ
  • Monday to Friday
  • The team starts at 7:30am Brazil time, so you need to be available for our daily meetings and team discussions
  • Looking for someone who can start as soon as possible


Please include a link to your Product Design portfolio in your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small design challenge and then talk us through how they approached it and why they made the decisions they did.

The Sherman, TX Plant Controller is responsible for financial planning, analysis, and reporting for the plant manufacturing unit. This role includes managing the plant accounting staff, overseeing production accounting and payroll, preparing weekly forecasts, and leading the budgeting process. The Controller partners with the Plant Operations team to drive cost savings initiatives, identify opportunities for performance improvement, and build a world-class plant accounting team.

  • Provide regular internal and external financial reporting and forecasting.

  • Develop business relationships with corporate personnel and plant management.
  • Support plant operations with credible financial analysis.
  • Lead preparation of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and weekly/monthly forecasts. Oversee the budgeting process and set policies and guidelines for plant accounting
  • Implement key controls for SOX compliance and conduct audits to ensure state and federal compliance. Identify and cultivate talent to build a world-class plant accounting team.

title: Shelter Worker (Casual)
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

JOB PURPOSE:

The Residential Worker B provides a safe and secure environment for residents and visitors.

CHARACTERISTIC JOB DUTIES:

The incumbent is responsible for the following range of job duties characteristic, or typical of the job class:

  • Monitors the activities of the clients/residents and maintains availability for personal, practical and morale support; may include providing safe storage and recording of prescribed medications
  • Accurately records day-to-day happenings using appropriate methods; maintains logbooks and completes occurrence reports
  • Liaises with referral sources and other external agencies as needed (e.g. welfare, police, parole, urgent situations)
  • Coordinates client care relating to security issues; may be directly involved in taking urine samples, doing bed checks, room/personal searches
  • May carry out inspection/security checks of property and grounds in accordance with policies and procedures
  • Handles the admission, orientation and evaluation of clients’ understanding of rules; ensures ongoing enforcement of policies, which may include client discipline
  • May handle finances relating to room rentals and meal tickets, and receipting of same
  • May serve as Receptionist for Shelter
  • May prepare or provide simple meals for clients/residents
  • Performs other duties as assigned


NOTE: Not all incumbents perform all of the duties described above but perform a similar range of duties.

MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL ATTAINED:

The successful job applicant will have completed high school, plus specialized courses of up to six (6) months (Addictions Facilities).

NOTE: An alternative level of education and experience may be acceptable.

SPECIAL LICENSES, DIPLOMAS, CERTIFICATIONS OR REQUIREMENTS:

The successful applicant will hold/have:

  • Addiction Facility – Addictions Counselling Courses
  • **See Precautionary Measures**

MINIMUM PRIOR RELATED EXPERIENCE:

The incumbent must have the following experience before hire:

More than three months but less than one year of prior related experience, including, experience with frontline work in a social services setting.

PHYSICAL EFFORT/DEXTERITY REQUIRED:

The performance of the job requires moderate amounts of keyboarding, and performing walk abouts.

CONCENTRATION REQUIRED:

The performance of the job requires continuously monitoring the environment, monitoring security cameras and attentiveness when interacting with clients and recording information.

RESPONSIBILITY FOR FINANCIAL RESOURCES:

The incumbent’s responsibility for Financial Resources:

The incumbent is involved in minor financial matters regularly, or on a relief basis, or has responsibility for the wise use of his/her own resources. He/She may be authorized to spend, disburse, or collect small amounts of cash. The incumbent has very little input into the annual budget.

RESPONSIBILITY FOR HUMAN RESOURCES:

The incumbent’s responsibility for Human Resources:

The incumbent is responsible for his/her own time and effort only. He/She may demonstrate work methods to new employees, volunteers and/or students.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The incumbent’s work environment is typically in a shelter and/or in treatment facilities.
The incumbent will work under the following disagreeable conditions:

  • Dealing with angry people
  • Abusive people
  • Verbal abuse
  • Isolation
  • Work schedule affecting lifestyle


The incumbent my have little to no travel required.
The incumbent carries a pager/walkie talkie and will work shift.

EXPOSURE TO HAZARDS:

The job incumbent may be exposed to the risk of minor to moderate injury or illnesses due to:

  • Physical attacks by others
  • Exposure to infectious diseases
  • Exposure to bodily fluids
  • Sharp objects
  • Other dangerous situations

PRECAUTIONARY MEASURES:

The incumbent must take the following precautionary measures (in addition to health and safety rules):

  • Universal precautions
  • Immunization for Hepatitis B
  • Vaccination against Tuberculosis
  • Current Certification in First Aid/CPR
  • Criminal Police Investigation Check (CPIC)
  • Non-violent crisis intervention training
  • Medication Training

Ability and willingness to undergo applicable screening and background checks successfully that are satisfactory to The Salvation Army, in its sole discretion (i.e., The Salvation Army Abuse Registry) and provide an original copy of a Background Check screening.

The pay rate is based on the Collective Agreement, not any other factors.

Compensation:

The target hiring range for this position is $22.98 to $23.10 with a maximum of $23.21.

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

The Salvation Army will provide reasonable accommodation upon request. Please email Recruitment.Accommodations@salvationarmy.ca if you have a need for any accommodation and we will be pleased to discuss this with you.

title: Finance Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Finance Coordinator

Location: South Africa

Job Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)

Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)

Our client is seeking a highly organised, proactive, and detail-oriented Finance Coordinator to support the financial and administrative operations of a growing organisation that operates approximately 15 skilled nursing facilities across New York.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and is confident managing multiple priorities independently.

The successful candidate will play a key role in coordinating financial and administrative activities relating to patient accounts, insurance administration, billing, payment collections, and communication with families and external agencies.

While experience within healthcare, skilled nursing, long-term care, or medical administration would be highly advantageous, we are primarily looking for a highly capable and resourceful individual with strong coordination, problem-solving, and organisational skills.

This role also offers excellent long-term growth potential, with the opportunity to develop into a more senior Finance Coordinator position and potentially provide Executive Assistant-style support to senior leadership as the organisation continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate financial and administrative activities across approximately 15 skilled nursing facilities.
  • Support the management of patient accounts, billing, insurance administration, payment collections, and outstanding balances.
  • Liaise professionally with families, internal departments, insurance providers, Social Security, Medicaid, and other relevant external agencies.
  • Manage multiple active cases, tasks, and projects simultaneously while ensuring deadlines are met.
  • Research, investigate, and independently resolve complex financial and administrative issues.
  • Track outstanding matters and proactively follow up to ensure they are driven through to completion.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant documentation, recognising when even minor errors may have significant financial or regulatory implications.
  • Provide regular updates on progress and escalate issues appropriately when required.
  • Assist with process improvements and support broader finance and administrative initiatives.
  • Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Adapt to changing priorities and provide additional coordination and administrative support as needed.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in finance coordination, healthcare administration, medical administration, patient coordination, project coordination, or a similar administrative role.
  • Experience within healthcare, skilled nursing, long-term care, social care, medical billing, insurance, finance, or patient administration would be highly advantageous.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, cases, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach with strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of tasks from start to finish.
  • Strong administrative and coordination skills, with the ability to keep complex processes organised and on track.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills and the ability to build professional relationships with a range of stakeholders.
  • Strong follow-up skills and the ability to proactively manage outstanding tasks.
  • Comfortable learning and working across multiple healthcare and business systems.
  • Adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced and changing environment.
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and accountability.
  • Fluent English with clear and professional communication skills.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer Cassandra
description:
At ING Hubs Spain we are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer Cassandra



Consulte la descripción del puesto a continuación. Si confía en que tiene las habilidades y la experiencia adecuadas, envíe su solicitud hoy mismo.

Your role and work environment:


In the Global Cloud Tribe, in the Data Services area a position is available for a Senior DevOps Engineer Cassandra.


The team

The purpose of the Global Cloud Tribe is to build and run the target infrastructure platform in a (private) cloud delivery model. This delivery model is based on multi-tenant, self-service, pay-per-use capabilities for application DevOps teams as defined in ING’s ‘One Way of Working’.


The Global Cloud Tribe comprises five Global Areas:

  • Infrastructure as a Service
  • Data Services
  • Integration Area
  • Cloud API Management
  • Container Area


The data Services Area provides Keyspace as a Service (KaaS) running on noSQL Cassandra. We do operate multitenant and dedicated Cassandra clusters.


KaaS is provided as a complete journey, our centre of expertise provides continued support and advice to teams using Cassandra. The data Services Area strives to be ahead of the game by keeping a close eye on all the metrics and logs to detect possible interruptions before they happen.


Tools like Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus are essential in our strive to provide a performant and resilient platform to our consumers.


Your key responsibilities:


With your pragmatic and delivery-oriented professional attitude, you put your background and experience to good use as an experienced engineer for the platform.

Together with the squad, the Product Manager and the architect, you design, build, test and maintain the KaaS related offerings in ING’s private cloud.


In addition, you use your automation experience and knowledge to propose solutions for modernizing and monitoring, to ensure robust and future proof operations and installations of our service.


As a Senior DevOps Engineer you will:


  • Take ownership of Cassandra Keyspace as a Service that the squad provides to tenants
  • Create and maintain code stored in Azure DevOps Repositories, distribute using the tools and pipelines
  • Be familiar with Agile / Scrum way of work
  • Be a strong team player and cooperate with global ING teams
  • Develop a view on improving the deployment and operational methods for our platform/service
  • Take part in our 24/7 standby schedule (once up to speed)
  • On a regular basis take the Ops-person-of-the-day task
  • Execute scheduled tasks that need to be executed to keep the risk score of the team’s services as low as possible


What are we looking for?


Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!


We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.


You are an energetic and proactive engineer with a true passion for IT and a positive “Do it-Try it-Fix it” mentality. You have good understanding of Dev/Ops and CI/CD. You are a natural team player who forms relationships based on social skills rather than hierarchical structure. As engineer you can share your knowledge in the team and coach other engineers when necessary.


Our ideal new colleague has:


  • Technical education, preferably in Information Technology
  • High level of English is a must (C1)
  • 5-10 years of experience in operational environment
  • Customer focused delivering proactive support
  • Platform engineering and full stack experience is preferred
  • Solid understanding of operating, maintaining and developing against NoSQL solutions (like Cassandra)
  • Experience with vSAN storage layer in VMware is hugely beneficial
  • Proficient to write scripts in languages like Python, Bash to automate daily tasks
  • Good understanding of the Linux operating system (RHEL)
  • Proficient in CI/CD tools from Microsoft Azure
  • Proficient in configuration management tool (Ansible)
  • Knowledge of GoLang is a nice to have
  • Focused on delivering quality above quantity
  • Strong conceptual understanding of the big picture is preferred
  • Attention to detail


What do we offer?


The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.


Check out what is waiting for you!


Be flexible my friend.

Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing.


Restaurant card.

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.


Our house will be your home.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!


Health insurance.

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).


Life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you.


Flexible remuneration.

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…


Transport allowance.

It doesnt matter where you live, we’ll help you get to the office.


Pension plan.

You can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!


Discover ING Hubs Spain


We’re building something exciting—and we want you to be part of it.

ING is launching the new member of ING Hubs in Spain, an integral part of ING in charge of designing and delivering important technological and operational solutions to make banking frictionless for our customers. ING Hubs play a key role in our ‘Growing the difference’ strategy to become the best European bank. This will be our sixth global hub, joining a network of over 13,000 professionals in the Philippines, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Türkiye and Spain.


What makes us different?


We have a tech-first mindset: We’re not just a bank—we’re a tech company that happens to do banking. Our new hub will be a center of excellence for scalable, fast, and secure technology.

We have global impact: You’ll be working on solutions that serve more than 34 million of customers in over 38 countries.

We are agile: ING was the first bank to adopt agile at scale. We continue to evolve with a collaborative, cross-functional way of working.

Sustainability at the heart of what we do: We have a role to play in defining new ways of doing business that align economic growth with positive environmental and social impact.


At ING, we believe in diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We’re proud of our international teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We value authenticity, collaboration, and continuous learning. xkdbapo


We’re looking for curious minds, bold builders, and passionate problem-solvers. If you’re looking for a place to find new ways to drive efficiency and provide superior customer value, where your ideas matter, and where you can grow with purpose—we’re looking forward to meeting you.

title: Assistant Garment Technologist - MP Activewear
description:
About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?

Role: Assistant Garment Technologist

Brand: MP Activewear

Reporting to: Garment Technologist

Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF (fully office based)

Life at THG Nutrition

THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.

Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.

The Role:

We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Assistant Garment Technologist to join the growing product team at MP Activewear, a performance-led sportswear brand creating functional, considered activewear designed to support movement and performance.

Working across our activewear collections, you will support the Garment Technologists in ensuring every product meets our high standards for fit, function, quality and performance. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a strong interest in sportswear and technical product who is looking to develop their career within a fast-paced, innovative brand.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Garment Technologists throughout the product development process, from initial development samples through to bulk production.
  • Assist with fit sessions by preparing samples, taking accurate notes, recording measurements and updating fit comments.
  • Measure and assess garments against technical specifications, size charts and approved standards.
  • Support the development of activewear products with a focus on fit, functionality, comfort and performance.
  • Help maintain accurate technical packs, specifications, size charts and product records.
  • Work closely Product Development and external Production teams to ensure clear communication throughout the development process.
  • Review and monitor sample quality, garment construction and workmanship, escalating any concerns where necessary.
  • Support communication with suppliers and manufacturers regarding fit, construction, workmanship and quality comments.
  • Assist with fabric and garment testing, care label approvals and relevant product compliance documentation.
  • Help ensure critical path deadlines are achieved by tracking samples, fit approvals and technical sign-offs.
  • Support the assessment of performance fabrics, trims and construction techniques to ensure products are suitable for their intended activity and end use.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in fit consistency, durability, performance and technical standards across MP Activewear collections.

About You:

  • Previous experience in an Assistant Garment Technologist, Junior Garment Technologist or Technical Assistant role, ideally within activewear, sportswear, athleisure or a related product category.
  • A qualification in Fashion, Clothing Technology, Garment Technology or a related discipline is desirable.
  • Good understanding of garment construction, grading, fabrics, fit and manufacturing processes.
  • An interest in technical and performance fabrics, including stretch materials and activewear construction, would be advantageous.
  • Confident measuring garments and interpreting technical specifications and size charts.
  • A strong eye for detail and organisation with an understanding of how fit, construction and fabrication can impact garment performance.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to build positive relationships with stakeholders and external suppliers.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities and working to deadlines in a fast-paced product environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Excel.
  • Positive, collaborative and eager to learn, with a genuine enthusiasm for activewear, sportswear and performance product.

What’s in it for me?

Career Development

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave.
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year.
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.

Wellbeing Support

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym.
  • Access to our on-site physio.

Other Perks

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.

  • On-site staff shop.
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation.
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.

description:

As a PI System Specialist, you will support the technical delivery of a major PI consolidation and migration programme. Here's what the role looks like:

  • Proven delivery experience across AVEVA PI System implementations, migrations or consolidation activity.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of PI Data Archive, Asset Framework, PI Interfaces, PI-to-PI and PI Vision.
  • Experience managing PI backup, restore, archive validation, data integrity and migration processes.
  • Strong experience working across integrated OT and IT environments, including secure network boundaries and DMZs.
  • Practical experience migrating PI AF structures, Analytics, Event Frames, interfaces, dashboards and displays.
  • Ability to validate integrations and data flows, diagnose issues and tune performance after migration.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver within the controls of a structured programme.
  • Strong technical documentation, stakeholder communication and problem-solving skills.

Requirements - Desirable

  • Experience delivering large-scale PI consolidation, integration or divestment programmes.
  • Knowledge of industrial network segmentation and architecture frameworks such as the Purdue Model or ISA-95.
  • Experience working with third-party PI Collectives.
  • Experience supporting users and operational teams through technical migration and hypercare.

Benefits

This 12 month contract opportunity will operate on a PAYE basis.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

title: GTM Intern
description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $20–$35 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a GTM internship on a two-sided marketplace, which means you will work on both halves of it: the companies deciding where to hire, and the candidates deciding where to go. The work is research-led rather than script-led. You will identify who is worth reaching, understand why the timing is right for them, write the outreach, and then look honestly at what the numbers say about whether it worked.

You will work directly with the founders and the operating team, and you will see the full arc from a name on a list to a real conversation. This is a good fit for someone who wants to learn go-to-market at a company where the messaging is still being figured out, and where a better-written email is measurably a better email.

Responsibilities

  • Research target companies and candidates, and turn that research into prioritized, specific outreach.
  • Write and send outbound across email and other channels, and iterate on messaging based on what replies.
  • Support both sides of the marketplace: sourcing candidates and supporting companies that are hiring.
  • Track outreach performance, report what is working, and propose the next test.
  • Keep pipeline data and records accurate enough to make decisions from.

Requirements

  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Interest in startups, recruiting, sales, marketplaces, or B2B software.
  • Comfort doing research and turning findings into action.
  • Organized and detail-oriented.
  • Able to manage several small projects at once.
  • Analytical mindset with a willingness to test, measure, and iterate.
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote startup environment.

title: Senior Systems Technician, Workstations & Servers
description:
Corsair is seeking a Senior Systems Technician to validate and troubleshoot high-end GPU workstation and server platforms for the Corsair Pro product line. The role is responsible for diagnosing and resolving hardware faults at the component and system level, determining root cause and preventing the issue from recurrence.

This role serves as the technical escalation point for manufacturing on build, test, and burn-in failures, directing diagnosis remotely through production line technicians and managing escalation to component and GPU vendors where required. The role also performs hands-on bench work on prototypes, reference units, and returned systems, and is responsible for ensuring findings are reflected in the build, test, and QA documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Troubleshooting & Failure Analysis

  • Root-cause hardware faults on multi-GPU workstations and servers — no-POST, no-boot, intermittent instability, unexpected shutdowns, performance degradation.
  • Diagnose GPU-specific failures: cards dropping off the PCIe bus, link width/speed negotiation issues, ECC/memory errors and row remapping, XID/driver-level faults, NVLink and fabric errors, VBIOS/firmware mismatches.
  • Isolate power delivery problems — PSU sizing and transient behavior, 12V-2x6/12VHPWR connector seating and integrity, riser and cable faults, rack-level power budgeting.
  • Investigate thermal issues: airflow path validation, inlet/delta-T measurement, throttling behavior under sustained load, fan curve and heatsink verification.
  • Diagnose failures on units you cannot physically access — working from supplied logs, photos, and test output, and by directing on-site technicians through a structured isolation sequence.
  • Read and interpret BMC/IPMI SEL logs, and other diagnostic outputs (dmesg, etc)

Manufacturer Troubleshooting & Escalation

  • Serve as the escalation point for manufacturing build, test, and burn-in failures — triage inbound issues, determine severity, and direct remote technicians through structured diagnostic steps to isolate root cause.
  • Use remote out-of-band access (BMC/IPMI, remote KVM, serial console) to diagnose manufacturing floor units directly where available, rather than relying solely on relayed observations.
  • Recommend containment where analysis indicates a systemic issue and provide the technical basis for that recommendation.
  • Work with manufacturing to document and resolve systemic issues via corrective actions and recommended improvements to the SOPs
  • Escalate to component and GPU vendors on the behalf of manufacturing — consolidate supplied evidence into vendor-grade failure reports, manage the case to closure, and push the resolution back down to every affected site.
  • Conduct first-article inspection and build sign-off on new platforms and configurations before volume production is released.
  • Perform periodic on-site or remote process audits: verify the manufacturing site is building to the current documentation revision and using specified procedures and requirements.

Build, Test & Validation

  • Work with manufacturing to maintain established software stack deployment procedures and processes and ensure documentation and compliance.
  • Validate that new platforms are buildable, testable, and repeatable.
  • Work with manufacturing to implement burn-in and QA/Verification processes, ensure documentation and compliance.

Documentation & Quality

  • Document and maintain processes for manufacturing processes involving assembly, burn-in, qualification
  • Maintain escapes/failures log to track for systemic issues

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years hands-on building, testing, and troubleshooting server and/or workstation-class systems in a production or integration environment.
  • Demonstrated component-level and system-level troubleshooting ability — able to isolate a fault to a part without swapping the whole system.
  • Experience troubleshooting hardware remotely through third-party or offsite technicians, including defining diagnostic steps and evidence requirements for people you don't directly supervise.
  • Working knowledge of server hardware fundamentals: PCIe topology, CPU/memory population rules, power delivery, thermal design, rack integration and cabling.
  • Experience with BMC/IPMI out-of-band management and firmware/BIOS updates.
  • Ability to communicate technical instruction clearly across sites and shifts

Preferred

  • Direct experience with high-TDP multi-GPU systems (NVIDIA RTX PRO / data center GPUs, AMD Instinct, Intel Arc Pro).
  • Experience with GPU diagnostic and stress tooling (DCGM, nccl-tests, gpu-burn, vendor field diagnostics).
  • Familiarity with high-speed networking (InfiniBand, 100/200/400/800GbE) and cluster-level bring-up, cable management/labeling schemas and documentation.
  • Experience managing manufacturers as a technical escalation owner — directing failure analysis, driving corrective action, and auditing build compliance across multiple sites.
  • Exposure to formal quality processes (QMS documentation, 8D/CAPA, metrics and KPI reporting).

description:
• Opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems start-ups, required cash handling, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day. Responsible for opening back door of store for deliveries.

Customer Experience
  • Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.

Operations
  • Responsible for holding store keys to open and close without management as necessary.

  • Attends training and completes PPLs requested by Manager.

title: Founders Associate Intern
description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $20–$35 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a Founders Associate internship working directly with the founders on whatever matters most that week. The work moves between strategy, analysis, and execution: scoping a question nobody has answered yet, doing the research, forming a recommendation, and then owning the follow-through until it is actually done. You will see how an early-stage company gets built from the inside, including the parts that are unglamorous and still undecided.

Because the team is small, the projects are real and the ownership is genuine. Expect limited structure, frequent context switching, and a high bar on written communication, since most decisions here are made from a well-argued document rather than a meeting.

Responsibilities

  • Own discrete, high-impact projects end to end for the founders, from framing the question through to the recommendation and the follow-through.
  • Research markets, competitors, customers, and internal data, and turn findings into clear written recommendations.
  • Move between strategy, analysis, and hands-on execution depending on what the week requires.
  • Build lightweight process and documentation where none exists, so the same work does not have to be redone.
  • Track commitments across the team and make sure decisions turn into action.

Requirements

  • Strong judgment, organization, and follow-through on work with limited supervision.
  • Excellent written communication, including the ability to synthesize a messy problem into a clear argument.
  • Strong research skills across both public sources and internal data.
  • Comfort switching between strategy, analysis, and execution.
  • Ability to work on ambiguous projects with limited structure.
  • High ownership mindset and self-direction in a remote startup environment.

title: Executive Director IS Sourcing and Category Management
description:
Calling All Esteemed Leaders! Are you a strategic sourcing and procurement leader who excels at driving transformation, optimizing supplier partnerships, and advancing technology-enabled solutions at enterprise scale? Do you thrive in complex environments where innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence are critical to success? If so, we invite you to explore this leadership opportunity with Providence.

The Role

The Executive Director, Procurement will be responsible for developing and leading Providence's Information Services sourcing and category management functions related to systems, processes, policies, analytics as well as advising on sourcing strategy, strategic planning, best practices and talent development.

The incumbent will transform IS Sourcing and Category Management into a strategic organization focused on optimizing the entire "Source to Settle" process to meet Providence St. Joseph Health Supply Chain and Information Services strategic and operational objectives. This will be achieved through leveraging three key areas:

  1. Internal "IS Category Management Organization" – In concert with our external business partner and our internal Operations Excellence team, internal business processes will be re-engineered to provide best-in-class IS sourcing and category management services.
  2. Emerging Technology and Market Strategy – Develop and utilize Providence's systems, analytics, market intelligence, and supplier strategies to create advanced and technologically enabled sourcing processes and category management functionality.
  3. Source to Settle – Partner with Information Services, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Finance, Risk Management, and senior business leaders to create a modernized "Source to Settle" capability that supports Providence's long-term digital strategy.

The position has overall accountability for enterprise technology category strategy and an Information Services portfolio representing approximately $1B in annual spend across software, infrastructure, cloud services, cybersecurity, telecommunications, clinical technologies, and outsourced technology services.

What You’ll Do

  • Oversee the IS sourcing and category management functions to maximize resources, optimize daily functions and effectively manage Providence's technology non-salary spend. Apply leading edge practices to optimize efficiency and accuracy.
  • Ensure appropriate training of staff and optimal use of resources including IT systems, sourcing tools, market intelligence and other related technology.
  • Execute overall compliance monitoring for IS sourcing and contracting practices. Review activity for related risks, privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Optimize supplier integration into sourcing, contracting, vendor management and strategic supplier governance. Provide consultation on supplier performance and/or contract language to confirm optimal supplier, pricing, service level and risk practices.
  • Work in partnership with Information Services, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Finance, Risk Management and sourcing to maintain technology roadmaps, supplier strategies and master data files current and updated.
  • Provide on-going education regarding processes to appropriate organizational leaders responsible for technology, supply and service acquisition. Include approval training for new management leaders.
  • Design, develop, and implement dashboards to track department performance against appropriate goals. Align metrics to key performance indicators, benchmarking, value realization and strategic supplier governance to improve performance and optimize resources.
  • Develop and maintain processes, policies, procedures, tools, and templates to ensure compliance, best practices, and sourcing excellence for IS sourcing and category management processes.
  • Maintain awareness and education of industry best practices. Best practices should be reviewed in healthcare technology and non-healthcare industries. Conduct benchmarking and communicate understanding of world class practices, as well as action plans to transition department to a world class operating state.
  • Develop and leverage internal and external partnerships and networks to maximize the achievement of business goals, executive stakeholder engagement and Providence's long-term digital strategy.
  • Cultivate an environment of creativity, constant innovation and evolution through leadership, aggressive and systematic goal setting plus enhanced communication and teamwork.
  • Secure periodic internal and external business partner satisfaction surveys.

What You’ll Bring

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or Accounting.
  • Master's Degree (preferred).

Experience & Expertise

  • 10 or more years of progressively responsible financial experience.
  • 5 years of Management experience.
  • 6 years of Experience leading IS sourcing, purchasing or contract management.
  • Experience with six sigma methodologies.
  • Finance management experience, including budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, benchmarking.
  • 5 years of experience in acute health care entity or multi-entity system (preferred).
  • Procure to pay experience (preferred).

Professional & Leadership Capabilities

  • Strategic thinking and thought leadership.
  • Ability to think in terms of possibilities and creates a clear vision and strategy, think broadly and understands interdependencies.
  • Change management/influencing skills, ability to build relationships and credibility.
  • Facilitate working sessions with large and small internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent decision making/judgment skills.
  • Drive a culture of change and continuous improvement and organizational excellence.
  • Strong interpersonal and team building skills to manage relationships between all levels across business units as well as externally.
  • Proactive, well-organized and highly motivated, must be a team player and have excellent written skills and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated strong analytical skills and ability for problem-solving.
  • Multi-tasking ability.
  • Strong leadership skills including the ability to influence senior management through effective communication and persuasive positioning.
  • Self-starter with positive "can do" attitude.
  • Able to manage multiple projects from conception to completion in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?

  • Enterprise Technology Impact: Lead sourcing and category management activities supporting an Information Services portfolio representing approximately $1B in annual spend across software, infrastructure, cloud services, cybersecurity, telecommunications, clinical technologies, and outsourced technology services.
  • Strategic Transformation Opportunity: Help transform IS Sourcing and Category Management into a strategic organization focused on optimizing the entire Source to Settle process.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Information Services, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Finance, Risk Management, Supply Chain, and executive leaders across the organization.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Drive best practices, supplier strategy, analytics, benchmarking, process improvement, and ongoing modernization in support of Providence's long-term digital strategy.

Ready to Shape the Future of Healthcare?

If you are a strategic procurement and sourcing leader with experience in category management, supplier strategy, technology sourcing, and organizational transformation, we encourage you to apply and help advance Providence's Information Services procurement capabilities and long-term digital strategy.

Final compensation will be determined based on qualifications, experience, organizational compensation alignment, and the approved hiring department budget for the position. Further, we want our leaders to live in or near the communities we serve. Therefore, leaders applying for this role will be required to work a hybrid schedule, which consists of four days onsite, one day remote and live within a reasonable commuting distance to the ministry or service area they support and lead.

title: R&D Engineering, Staff Engineer - DevOps (f/m) - ibiza
description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You have built and scaled platforms that actually run in production, not proof-of-concepts that look good in slides. You know that Kubernetes is powerful, but also that it can become a mess fast if the design decisions are not made with scale and maintainability in mind.

  • Perform complex development activities that may require extensive analysis in areas including cloud deployment and maintenance, as well as distributed system maintenance and scaling

  • Enable Engineers to deploy models that reduce simulation time from hours to minutes, directly accelerating product innovation for Synopsys customers
  • Scale the platform to handle growing customer demand without degrading performance or reliability
  • Reduce mean time to recovery during incidents by building better observability and automated remediation into the platform
  • Improve developer velocity by streamlining deployment workflows and eliminating friction in the release process
