  • Mentor engineers across the organization through RFCs, documentation, and pairing sessions that raise the bar on platform thinking
What You'll Need
  • Software development certification
  • 3 years’ experience, including managing complex platforms that leverage the Kubernetes technology
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills
  • Distributed systems design and operation experience (Kubernetes, Pulumi, NATS, Redis)
  • Proficiency in scripting with Bash and programming in Python or TypeScript
  • Comfort working independently and owning problems end to end, from definition through deployment and monitoring
Who You Are
  • You can explain a complex infrastructure tradeoff to a researcher in two sentences without losing the nuance or talking down to them
  • When something breaks in production, you stay calm, gather data, and methodically work the problem instead of guessing and restarting things
  • You care about the \"why\" behind a request, if someone asks for a new service, you ask what problem they are trying to solve before you start provisioning resources
  • You are curious enough to test new tools and pragmatic enough to know when the old tool is still the right answer
  • You can work across time zones with a distributed team, which means clear written communication and async collaboration are second nature to you
The Team You'll Be Part Of
The SimAI platform is a SaaS-based platform that brings unprecedented speed, innovation, and accessibility to simulation. It is based on proprietary Deep learning algorithms at the forefront of AI. It empowers users to make faster decisions, faster iterations, and faster innovation. You will collaborate with a team of experts who are, together, building the future of computer-assisted system design.
Rewards And Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: AI/ML Engineering Intern
description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $35–$50 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is an applied AI internship inside a product where the model output is the product. We use LLMs to read unstructured professional histories, extract structure from them, score candidates against a role, and rank what a recruiter sees first. Every one of those steps can be confidently wrong, so the interesting work is as much about evaluating quality as it is about building the pipeline.

You will work on real LLM workflows against messy data at volume: designing prompts and extraction logic, building the evaluations that tell you whether a change actually helped, and improving ranking and retrieval where the current answer is not good enough. This is applied rather than research work, and you will be able to see the effect of what you build on what real users get.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve LLM workflows for extraction, scoring, and ranking against real product data.
  • Design evaluations that measure output quality, and use them to judge whether a change is an improvement.
  • Work with messy, high-volume unstructured data and turn it into reliable structure.
  • Improve retrieval and ranking so the most relevant results surface first.
  • Investigate incorrect or low-quality output and trace it back to its cause.

Requirements

  • Strong programming fundamentals in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or a similar language.
  • Interest in applied AI, machine learning, LLMs, ranking, retrieval, or data systems.
  • Comfort working with messy data and evaluating output quality.
  • Has built AI/ML, data, class, research, or side projects.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.

title: Top Secret Night Superintendent
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Procon is a top-ranked construction management and technology consulting firm with 25 years of experience delivering high‑impact projects across the U.S. and worldwide. An ENR Top 100 CM/PM firm for five consecutive years, we specialize in program management, project controls, commissioning, and technology—and offer an excellent platform to grow your career while shaping the future of the built environment.

Procon seeks an experienced night shift Superintendent to support construction activities in a highly secure, occupied historic federal facility in downtown Washington, DC. The superintendent will work closely with the General Contractor, federal stakeholders, trade subcontractors, and project team to safely execute after-hours renovation and construction work while minimizing disruption to building occupants and maintaining strict security, quality, and schedule requirements.

This role requires a field-focused construction professional with demonstrated experience leading subcontractors, conducting coordination meetings, communicating project status, and managing work in secure federal government environments. An active Top Secret security clearance is required.

The selected individual will work primarily during night time and after-hours construction periods and may be required to work weekends or holidays depending on project needs. The role requires regular presence in active construction areas and the ability to walk the site, climb stairs, inspect work in constrained spaces, and use appropriate personal protective equipment. This role requires various skills and experience as listed below.

Requirements

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience in construction supervision, field management, or a Superintendent role.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with a General Contractor on commercial, institutional, federal, or complex renovation projects.

  • Experience supervising and coordinating multiple subcontractor trades, including sequencing work within active and occupied facilities.

  • Federal government construction experience, including secure-site access, project documentation, stakeholder coordination, and facility operational requirements.

  • Demonstrated occupied-renovation experience, preferably within mission-critical, high-security, or continuously operating facilities.

  • Active Top Secret security clearance required, with the ability to maintain clearance eligibility throughout employment.

  • Strong knowledge of construction means and methods, trade coordination, quality control, jobsite safety, scheduling, and field documentation.

  • Proven ability to lead meetings, communicate with diverse stakeholders, and resolve field issues efficiently and professionally.

  • Ability to work night shifts and adjust work hours based on project operations, security requirements, and construction schedules.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and experience preparing daily reports, meeting notes, and field correspondence.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field preferred. Relevant construction management or Superintendent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Experience with historic federal facilities, protected or landmarked buildings, and historic preservation requirements preferred.

  • Experience supporting federal agencies, GSA-managed facilities, or other secure government environments.

  • OSHA 30-Hour Construction certification preferred.

  • Experience with construction scheduling tools, Procore or similar project management systems, and electronic daily reporting platforms preferred.

  • Knowledge of MEP systems, life-safety systems, temporary conditions, shutdown coordination, and commissioning-related activities preferred.

  • Strong field leadership, construction supervision, and subcontractor management skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with contractors, client representatives, building occupants, and security personnel.

  • Ability to prioritize competing activities and make sound, timely decisions in an active construction environment.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly regarding security, safety, building protection, and construction quality.

  • Professional judgment, discretion, and reliability when working within sensitive federal environments.

  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, schedules, submittals, RFIs, and phasing plans.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Serve as the primary on-site construction representative during nighttime and after-hours work shifts.

  • Coordinate daily and weekly nighttime construction activities with the General Contractor, subcontractors, facility representatives, security personnel, and project stakeholders.

  • Conduct pre-shift coordination meetings, safety briefings, and look-ahead planning sessions with trade contractors and project personnel.

  • Review and manage planned work activities to ensure compliance with approved schedules, phasing plans, security procedures, permits, and building operational constraints.

  • Monitor subcontractor performance, manpower, material deliveries, access requirements, work sequencing, and completion of assigned tasks.

  • Verify construction work complies with contract documents, approved submittals, project specifications, applicable codes, quality-control requirements, and historic-preservation constraints.

  • Identify conflicts, field conditions, access limitations, and schedule risks, and coordinate timely resolution with the General Contractor and project team.

  • Maintain accurate records of nighttime operations, including daily reports, progress photographs, manpower logs, safety observations, deficiencies, incidents, and stakeholder communications.

  • Provide timely updates to project stakeholders regarding completed work, upcoming activities, impacts to building occupants, safety concerns, schedule issues, and required decisions.

  • Coordinate shutdowns, tie-ins, utility work, material movement, and other potentially disruptive activities to protect occupied building operations.

  • Enforce project safety requirements and maintain a clean, orderly, and secure work environment throughout each shift.

  • Protect historic building features, finishes, and sensitive building systems during construction activities.

  • Coordinate construction access, escorting requirements, staging, and secure-area procedures in accordance with federal facility protocols.

  • Participate in progress meetings, coordination meetings, quality-control inspections, and turnover or closeout activities as required.

Benefits

Salary commensurate with experience.

Interested and qualified candidates please submit a cover letter and a resume.

Procon offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, including full medical/dental insurance and 401(K) plan. Procon is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected factor.

title: Lead Engineer ICT/ ELV - Data Center - Chennai / Noida / Mumbai / Hyderabad
description:
Key Responsibilities

The Principal ELV & IBMS Engineer will act as a systems architect and technical lead responsible for end-to-end ELV system design, IBMS architecture, integration strategy, and commissioning support.

This role goes beyond equipment specification and requires complete lifecycle ownership, from system architecture definition and integration strategy through detailed design, vendor evaluation, testing procedures, and live commissioning validation.

You will lead cross-discipline conversations on BMS-electrical interfaces (EPMS integration, power monitoring), mechanical coordination (HVAC sensor networks, control logic), security integration (SOC workflows, surveillance architecture), and IT systems (DCIM, network protocols). Therefore, it's required to possess working knowledge of electrical systems (power monitoring, EPMS interfaces), mechanical systems (HVAC controls, sensor networks), fire safety (FAS integration, alarm management), security operations, network architecture, and commissioning procedures.

Client Engagement & Technical Leadership

  • Act as the primary ELV/ICTtechnical contact for clients, leading system architecture discussions, integration strategy, and operational readiness with senior engineering and operations teams
  • Directly engage with client-side SMEs, security operations centres (SOC), IT teams, global stakeholders, and multidisciplinary design teams
  • Lead technical discussions on system integration philosophy, resilience architecture, protocol strategy, and operational workflows
  • Own preparation of IBMS Design Basis Reports (DBR), system architecture narratives, cause & effect matrices, and integration strategy documentation
  • Participate in proposals drafting and responses to RFP and TQR

System Architecture

  • Define complete ELV/IBMS architecture including BMS/EPMS/DCIM integration, security systems (CCTV/VMS, access control, perimeter protection), fire alarm systems (FAS, VESDA), PA/VA systems, and operational workflows
  • Design integrated systems for hyperscale and colocation facilities in the 10–100 MW IT load range, with security zoning and network architecture scaled to mission-critical requirements
  • Develop multi-layer security architecture
  • Design HVAC monitoring and control integration with electrical power monitoring
  • Establish system redundancy philosophy aligned with uptime requirements and Tier III/IV standards
  • Develop network topology and sequence of operations for integrated system behavior

Engineering Analysis & System Integration

  • Design end-to-end BMS/IBMS solution: PLC architecture, server redundancy, communication protocols (BACnet, Modbus, IEC-61850, OPC UA), and control logic
  • Develop complete I/O lists, control logic, and cause & effect matrices for all integrated systems
  • Coordinate electrical integration, EPMS data flows, power monitoring sensors, emergency shutdown sequences, and load shedding logic
  • Coordinate mechanical integration, HVAC sensor networks, chiller/CDU control loops, and thermal management feedback into IBMS
  • Design security operation centre (SOC) workflows, alarm management strategy, and operator interface logic
  • Validate system protocols and redundancy across all integration points; ensure alignment with TIA-942, ISO 27001 (physical security), and local fire safety standards

Detailed Design & Documentation

  • Lead development of ELV schematics, IBMS architecture diagrams, network topology drawings, and equipment schedules through IFC stage
  • Review and approve AutoCAD & BIM (Revit) models at LOD350 with coordinated multi-discipline integration
  • Prepare technical specifications, equipment BOQs, network schedules, and integration test procedures
  • Develop vendor selection criteria, lead technical evaluations, and conduct submittal reviews ensuring compliance with system architecture

Construction, Testing & Commissioning Support

title: Onsite Immigration Specialist- Dallas, TX or New York, NY
description:
On-site Immigration Specialist

This role is required to be on-site either in NYC or Dallas, TX.

The Immigration Specialist will be based on-site at one of Cartus’ major financial services clients. Our client’s Americas immigration team is part of the firm’s Global Mobility function. The Immigration Specialist plays an integral role within the firm’s Americas immigration team and serves as a key liaison to various stakeholders throughout the firm to ensure the successful execution of our immigration strategy. Optimal candidate will have a solid foundation in both nonimmigrant and immigrant visa and green card matters and appreciates the importance of policy and process. Team player attitude and strong analytical and critical thinking skills are a must. Job duties include but not limited to below:

  • Independently manage caseload for both nonimmigrant and immigrant/green card and visa matters
  • Track work accordingly and exercise good judgement when escalating matters
  • Proactively manage caseload and liaise with external immigration counsel and HR teams to ensure immigration milestones are being met
  • Advise and guide stakeholders (e.g., business partners and managers) on immigration-related business decisions, ensuring adherence to firm policies and guidance from counsel
  • Update stakeholders on immigration developments impacting employee population
  • Liaise with external immigration counsel on ad hoc issues related to US government inquiries, Canada or LatAm immigration issues for local employees
  • Assist with immigration issues as necessary for interns and new hires
  • Serve as project team member working on one or more phases of several annual immigration-related projects (e.g. annual H-1B visa lottery), when applicable
  • Assist with updating policy/process and project plan documentation (e.g., employee FAQs, immigration resources, standardized communications)
  • Assist with ad-hoc reporting/metrics requests
  • Conduct data validation on immigration support documentation for Americas (mostly US) immigration filings to the government
  • Collaborate with other members of the Global Mobility team on immigration considerations and drivers for relocations

EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

To be successful in performing and developing this role, the candidate will need to demonstrate strength and experience in a majority of the following areas:

  • 3+ years minimum of corporate US immigration experience in both nonimmigrant and immigrant/green card and visa matters
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Analytical rigor with a proven ability to perform data audits, ensuring complete accuracy in government filings and internal record-keeping Client service focus, responsiveness and a “can-do” open minded attitude
  • Strong organizational skills, proactive approach
  • Self-starter, ability to work well independently as well as in a team environment
  • Good communication and relationship management skills – ability to explain complex immigration processes to stakeholders in simple terms
  • Understands the importance of confidentiality and sensitivity of immigration information
  • Ability to prioritize workload and meet deadlines
  • Good judgement and critical thinking – the ability to identify potential legal or timeline bottlenecks and escalate with proposed solutions
  • Familiar with operating as part of a global team
  • Enthusiastic, positive, and keen to learn and develop
  • Proficiency with Excel, particularly V-lookups and pivot tables
  • Prior exposure to Global Mobility field is advantageous, although not essential
  • Willingness to work overtime, particularly during peak immigration cycles

description:

Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington is currently recruiting a Principal Counsel to join the Employment Law and Employment Relations team in Te Pūmanawa Tāngata - Human Resources on a permanent, full-time basis.

title: Warehouse Technician - Las Vegas
description:
Position Overview

The Warehouse Technician (WO) is responsible for supporting warehouse operations and any projects as assigned. The Warehouse Technician plays a crucial role in supporting warehouse operations and executing various projects as assigned. This position primarily focuses on the shipping and receiving of orders, quality control, inventory management, and other logistics-related tasks. The Warehouse Technician will report directly to the Supervisor of Warehouse Operations or the Manager of Warehouse Operations.

Key Job Responsibilities

Inbound/Outbound Order Processing:

• Utilize advanced Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) to efficiently process receiving, shipping, and labeling of products.

• Execute quality control processes using AI-driven defect detection systems and random inspections.

• Implement lean management principles to optimize inventory control and reduce waste.

• Utilize real-time inventory tracking systems and IoT devices for accurate stock management.

Logistics and Transportation:

• Process shipments using automated systems for small parcel, LTL, and fleet deliveries.

• Operate and interact with modern warehouse equipment, including automated guided vehicles (AGVs) and automated storage systems.

• Maintain proficiency in operating traditional equipment such as forklifts, reach trucks, and powered pallet jacks.

• Utilize route optimization software and real-time tracking systems for efficient delivery management.

Safety:

• Conduct comprehensive safety checks using digital inspection tools and IoT-enabled equipment monitoring.

• Participate in regular safety training programs, including updated OSHA certifications.

• Follow ergonomic best practices and proper lifting techniques to prevent workplace injuries.

• Maintain hazard communication (HazCom) compliance and emergency response preparedness.

Warehouse Housekeeping:

• Implement 5S principles (Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain) for workspace organization.

• Perform preventive maintenance using predictive analytics and IoT-enabled monitoring systems.

• Maintain cleanliness standards in accordance with modern warehouse practices.

• Support sustainable and eco-friendly warehouse practices.

Customer Service:

• Conduct comprehensive safety checks using digital inspection tools and IoT-enabled equipment monitoring.

• Participate in regular safety training programs, including updated OSHA certifications.

• Follow ergonomic best practices and proper lifting techniques to prevent workplace injuries.

• Maintain hazard communication (HazCom) compliance and emergency response preparedness.

Job Qualifications

• High School diploma or GED

• 1+ years of warehouse experience with exposure to modern warehouse technologies

• Demonstrated proficiency in operating warehouse equipment and safety protocols

• Physical ability to lift 50+ lbs and perform warehouse tasks following ergonomic guidelines

Technical Skills

• Experience with modern Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and inventory control software

• Proficiency in using RF scanners, barcode systems, and RFID technology

• Basic understanding of automation and robotics in warehouse operations

• Competency in Microsoft Office and warehouse-specific software applications

Preferred Qualifications

• Technical certification in warehouse operations or related field

• Experience with automated warehouse systems and IoT devices

• Certified Maintenance and Reliability Technician (CMRT) certification

• Knowledge of lean management principles and continuous improvement methodologies

Soft Skills

• Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical thinking

• Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration

• Adaptability to new technologies and processes

• Commitment to safety and quality standards

• Team-oriented mindset with strong customer service focus

Work Environment

Warehouse

Work is performed in a modern warehouse environment and occasionally at event venues. The warehouse environment may include exposure to outdoor temperatures, dust, dirt, and other environmental factors. Team members must adhere to appearance guidelines as defined by the company, both in the warehouse and when representing the organization at venues or during travel.

The work environment incorporates industry best practices to ensure safety and efficiency, including:

• Climate control systems in designated areas to mitigate extreme temperatures and improve worker comfort.

• Dust and air quality management systems, such as industrial air filtration, to reduce exposure to airborne particles.

• Ergonomic workstations and lifting aids to minimize physical strain and reduce the risk of musculoskeletal injuries.

The working conditions may vary between moderately quiet to noisy volumes, depending on the tasks being performed and the equipment in use. Team members will frequently interact with high-end audio-visual equipment, electrical components, and automated systems, requiring adherence to strict safety protocols.

Work schedules may include irregular hours, on-call status, and shifts during days, evenings, weekends, and holidays to meet operational demands. Team members are expected to follow safety guidelines and participate in regular training programs to maintain a safe and productive work environment.

Office

Work is performed primarily in an office environment with occasional travel to event venues or warehouses. The office environment is typically climate-controlled and free from significant physical hazards. Team members must adhere to appearance guidelines as defined by the company when working in the office or representing the organization externally.

Working times may include irregular hours, on-call status, and shifts during days, evenings, weekends, and holidays to support operational needs. Team members are expected to collaborate with warehouse staff and other departments using modern communication tools and collaborative platforms.

title: Sr. Clinical Research Engineer - Future Forward
description:
Primary Function of Position

The Senior Clinical Research Engineer, Future Forward, will lead the design and development of new product concepts prior to commercial launch by leveraging in-depth clinical, scientific, and technical expertise. This individual will collaborate closely with engineers, physicians, interaction designers, human factors, training and technical publication specialists, and various internal and external stakeholders to guide product and procedure development. The Senior Clinical Research Engineer will play a key role in proctoring early-stage feasibility clinical studies, gathering case insights to support technology advancement, identifying and documenting user needs, managing product requirements, assessing clinical risks, and providing design guidance for clinical and commercial design and development. This individual will develop and execute pre-clinical experimental strategies to evaluate device performance, safety, and usability through the Product Development Process (PDP) ensuring readiness for commerical launch. The Senior Clinical Research Engineer will also work with cross-functional teams—including regulatory, quality, clinical affairs, and finance—to shape clinical indications and commercialization strategies, driving the technology from concept to a commercial-ready product.

Essential Job Duties

The Senior Clinical Research Engineer will:

Pre-clinical research and commercial concept development:

  • Lead the design and development of new product concepts prior to commercial launch by leveraging in-depth clinical, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Research disease states and medical technologies associated with new business opportunities to become an expert on new products and their clinical applications.
  • ​Collaborate with marketing partners and clinicians to identify and understand marketing needs.
  • Work with key opinion leaders, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to identify clinical goals and translate those needs into user-centric designs for new platforms, procedures, instruments, and accessories.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers and physicians to define and evaluate clinical performance goals, potential safety and usability risks for new products in early-phase development.
  • Develop and execute clinical derisking pathways, including pre-clinical and clinical feasibility studies, to ensure technology advancement and readiness for commercial launch.
  • Conduct design iteration assessments of products both internally and with external key opinion leaders.
  • Develop and execute a preclinical evaluation strategy in advance of human trials and for regulatory submissions.
  • Provide subject matter expertise to user manual and training documentation development.
  • Support regulatory documentation and submissions.
  • Demonstrate an analytical approach to identify potential product enhancements and new product ideas.

Clinical research and innovation:

  • Lead and execute early-stage feasibility clinical studies, pilot and pivotal clinical trials to support technology development for regulatory and reimbursement strategies.
  • Identify and drive product enhancements and new product ideas by applying an analytical approach to understanding the clinical needs of physicians and users.
  • Collect and analyze clinical study insights to inform new product requirements, training needs, manage clinical risks adhering to quality management systems.
  • Design, develop, and execute clinical evaluations of prototypes with the ability to translate feedback to the engineering team for technology acceleration.
  • Develop intellectual property for novel clinical applications and technologies.

Others:

  • Keep the organization’s vision and values at the forefront of decision making and action.
  • Perform other duties as required to support the company's overall strategy and goals.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Fluent in medical procedure terminology and sound knowledge of anatomy.
  • Ability to understand complex robotic systems and software algorithms.
  • Experience working in an operating room or interventional suite environment.
  • Experience collaborating with physicians and collecting feedback on clinical use of the product.
  • Excellent mechanical and technical aptitude, and intuition for spatial relations, including the ability to understand complex mechanical products.
  • Excellent analytical capability and practical skills to develop and test a clinical hypothesis and draw succinct conclusions.
  • Excellent teamwork skills with proven ability to cultivate collaboration across multiple disciplines to ensure timely project success.
  • Proven success recognizing critical issues and driving them to closure by taking coordinated action.
  • Product development and Design Controls experience.
  • Effective communication skills (verbal, written, presentation).
  • Self-starter needing minimal supervision.
  • Self-confident and able to react quickly under pressure.

Required Education and Training

  • Minimum of a B.S. in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or similar.
  • 8+ years of related experience in clinical engineering and/or product development within the medical device industry.

Working Conditions

  • Must be available to work full-time and commute/relocate to Sunnyvale, CA.
  • Up to 30% travel. Some international travel will be required.
  • Primary Location: Sunnyvale, CA.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with on-site clinical trial support a plus.
  • Experience with commerical product launch a plus.
  • Familiar with intellectual property development and patent assessment

title: Value Delivery Manager - Supply Chain
description:
Acting as the central PMO lead, this position brings structure, visibility and accountability across complex, multi-workstream programmes. Working closely with project teams, senior leaders, transformation stakeholders and external partners, the role supports the successful delivery of large-scale infrastructure, automation and technology-enabled change from planning and procurement through to implementation, operational handover and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will bring proven PMO, project coordination or programme support experience gained within large-scale logistics, supply chain, automation or transformation environments. Strong planning, governance and reporting skills are essential, alongside advanced Microsoft Project and Excel capabilities. This role would suit someone who is highly organised, analytical and confident managing multiple priorities, producing executive-level reporting and engaging stakeholders at all levels. Experience across end-to-end project lifecycles, Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, and the use of collaboration and AI-enabled tools to drive efficiency will be highly valued. A PRINCE2, APM or equivalent qualification is required.

NB: The role will be based from one of our Logistics hubs, Bradford, Castle Donington, Welham Green or our Waterside Support Centre dependent on the successful candidate’s location. This role will involve regular travel to sites across the country.

What you’ll do

Your key accountabilities will include:

  • Own and maintain integrated project plans, coordinating schedules, milestones and dependencies across multiple workstreams to ensure successful delivery of complex logistics and transformation programmes

  • Drive governance excellence, managing RAID, change control, reporting and programme controls while ensuring adherence to PMO frameworks, delivery standards and stage-gate processes

  • Provide clear performance insight to senior stakeholders through executive-ready dashboards, reporting packs and analysis that support decision-making, risk management and delivery assurance

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and external partners, maintaining alignment across technology, operations, suppliers, contractors and vendors to manage interdependencies and keep delivery on track

  • Support programme delivery from concept to operational handover, tracking actions, budgets, risks, milestones and key deliverables to drive accountability, maintain momentum and ensure successful outcomes

Who you are

Your skills and experience will include:

  • Demonstratable experience supporting large-scale transformation programmes within logistics, supply chain, retail, automation or systems implementation environments, with strong PMO, governance and project coordination expertise
  • Advanced Microsoft Project and Excel skills, including project planning, dependency management, critical path analysis, reporting, data analysis and tracker management
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage at all levels while delivering accurate, insightful and executive-ready reporting
  • Experience managing complex, multi-workstream projects, coordinating dependencies, risks, issues and interdependencies across diverse stakeholder groups in fast-paced environments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with experience using digital collaboration tools and AI-enabled solutions to improve reporting, governance and delivery efficiency.

What’s in it for you?

Working at M&S means being part of something bigger - helping to deliver quality, value and service to millions of customers every day. We’re inclusive, fast-moving and always evolving, with a strong sense of purpose and a focus on doing the right thing.

Here are just a few of the benefits that make working here even more rewarding:

  • 20% colleague discount on all M&S products and many third-party brands for you and someone in your household, available once you’ve completed your probation
  • Competitive holiday allowance with the option to buy more
  • Strong pension and life assurance to help plan for the future
  • Tailored induction and training to support your development from day one
  • Exclusive perks and savings through our M&S Choices portal
  • Market-leading family policies, including parental, adoption and neonatal leave
  • 24/7 wellbeing support, including virtual GP access and mental health services
  • One paid volunteer day a year to support a cause that matters to you

Everyone’s welcome

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re reinventing, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re redefining how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks & Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen.

We are committed to building diverse and representative teams, where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and be at their best. We support each other and work together to win together.

Job Description:

Project Officer bertanggung jawab dalam melakukan implementasi program dengan mengembangkan kapasitas masyarakat dan kemitraan terutama di tingkat desa, penguatan kelembagaan, memfasilitasi dan memperkuat pelaksanaan inisiatif-inisiatif yang dilakukan masyarakat untuk meningkatkan dan mempertahankan kesejahteraan anak dan keluarganya, serta guna memastikan keberlanjutan dan dampak program.

Tentang Proyek MARVEL :

Tanam Mangrove untuk Lombok Timur yang Lebih Hijau | Wahana Visi Indonesia

Pengembangan Strategi dan Perencanaan:

  • Mendukung tim ADP dan tim proyek dalam membangun visi masyarakat layanan tentang pengembangan transformatif yang berfokus pada anak dan perencanannya.
  • Memberikan bimbingan kepada masyarakat dalam mengidentifikasi masalah-masalah yang dihadapi, menentukan prioritas pelaksanaan program berdasarkan kebutuhannya, kesempatan yang ada dan kemampuan masyarakat yang sejalan dengan desain proyek/ADP dan perencanaan kerja tahunan ADP/proyek.
  • Membuat perencanaan bersama masyarakat melalui koordinasi dan konsultasi secara berkala untuk update perencanaan tahunan, 3 bulanan maupun bulanan yang akan menjadi masukan dalam pembuatan perencanaan proyek secara keseluruhan.
  • Memberikan bimbingan kepada masyarakat untuk membuat perencanaan advokasi penanggulangan bencana berbasiskan masyarakat dan ketangguhan menghadapi perubahan iklim.

Pengelolaan dan Penggalangan Sumber Daya:

  • Memberikan bimbingan kepada masyarakat dalam mengidentifikasi sumber daya yang ada, feasibility, manajemen risiko dan siap untuk terlibat dalam pelaksanaan program.
  • Mendukung APM/Coordinator dalam mempersiapkan pelaksanaan program sponsorship/non-sponsorship di wilayahnya dan menjadi penanggungjawab persiapan tersebut dan pelaksanaannya.

Pengembangan Kapasitas:

  • Mengembangkan kapasitas masyarakat dan para mitra dalam hal karakter, kompetensi dan komitmennya untuk mendukung pelaksaan program agar berjalan dengan baik dan kesejahteraan anak dan keluarga dapat terwujud.
  • Mengembangkan kesadaran masyarakat untuk bersikap kritis terhadap isu dan kesempatan yang ada di masyarakat dalam rangka perwujudan kesejahteraan anak dan keluarga.
  • Melatih masyarakat dan para mitra dalam mengembangkan kemampuan pengelolaan inisiatif lokal.
  • Melakukan proses refleksi dan pembelajaran dari pelaksanaan program bersama masyarakat, termasuk anak dan masyarakat yang paling rentan, dan mitra.
  • Berbagi pembelajaran dan laporan pelaksanaan program kepada masyarakat dan mitra terkait.

Akuntabilitas dan Pengendalian Kualitas:

  • Melakukan kegiatan bersama masyarakat sesuai perencanaan di dalam Detail Implementation Project (DIP) dan logframe proyek yang berkontribusi terhadap pencapaian ITT secara tepat waktu, sesuai standar dan anggaran yang ditetapkan.
  • Memberikan pendampingan dan pelatihan teknis pengembangan masyarakat, yang meliputi pengelolaan proyek, pelaksanaan kegiatan sesuai dengan perencanaan, pelaporan, sistem komunikasi dan monitoring internal dan evaluasi pelaksanaan kegiatan.
  • Memfasilitasi proses pengorganisasian masyarakat di tingkat desa.
  • Memberikan rekomendasi kepada tim proyek untuk revisi perencanaan dan anggaran di tingkat desa berdasarkan proses monitoring, refleksi dan pembelajaran pelaksanaan program bersama masyarakat dan mitra.
  • Melakukan proses dialog bersama masyarakat dan mitra secara inklusif.
  • Berkontribusi dalam pembuatan laporan proyek/ADP setiap bulan, kuartal maupun tahunan.
  • Melakukan kunjungan rumah kepada masyarakat dampingan untuk membangun hubungan intrapersonal dalam pendekatan pengembangan masyarakat sesuai jadwal yang telah ditetapkan.

Pengembangan Jejaring dan Koordinasi:

  • Membangun kemitraan dengan berbagai organisasi, institusi dan kelembagaan di tingkat desa yang dibangun berdasarkan kesamaan fokus untuk meningkatkan kesejahteraan anak dan keluarga, terutama bagi anak dan keluarga yang paling rentan.
  • Memfasilitasi dan mengelola hubungan dengan masyarakat dan mitra pengembangan masyarakat tingkat desa, termasuk dengan Pemerintah Desa, organisasi kemasyarakatan yang ada, komunitas berbasis iman, komunitas berbasis lingkungan, pihak swasta dan tokoh-tokoh masyarakat.
  • Memberikan informasi yang akurat tentang identitas organisasi.
  • Meningkatkan pemahaman tentang situasi politik di wilayah pelayanan agar dapat menyikapinya dengan baik sebagai perwakilan organisasi.

Kepemimpinan dan Manajemen:

  • Tinggal di wilayah pelayanan untuk memberikan kesaksian Kristiani terkait pengembangan masyarakat untuk kesejahteran anak dan keluarga.
  • Mendokumentasikan proses implementasi di lapangan termasuk penyampaian laporan perkembangan kegiatan setiap bulan kepada atasan.
  • Membangun lingkungan kerja yang positif, saling menghargai dan memperdulikan.
  • Mempraktikan spiritualitas dan doa dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

Kualifikasi

  • Pengalaman kerja minimal 3 tahun atau sebagai fasilitator pengembangan minimal 1 tahun di program kemanusiaan.
  • Diutamakan berpengalaman dalam membangun koordinasi antara lembaga/institusi pemerintahan tingkat kecamatan dan kabupaten dengan organisasi kemanusiaan.
  • Familiar dengan situasi dan kondisi masyarakat pesisir pesisir, serta kegiatan lapangan terutama menanam dan program pendampingan peningkatan ekonomi masyarakat.
  • Lebih diutamakan merupakan lulusan S-1 dari jurusan Sosial, dan terbuka juga dari jurusan lainnya.
  • Memiliki keterampilan yang baik dalam hal memfasilitasi dan membangun hubungan interpersonal.
  • Terbiasa menggunakan aplikasi digital dan terus belajar untuk bisa mempercepat proses dokumentasi yang baik.
  • Memahami konsep pengembangan dan mobilisasi masyarakat.
  • Memiliki keterampilan yang baik dalam hal berpikir kritis dan analitis.
  • Pengenalan akses dari kondisi wilayah pelayanan dari kantor Area Program
  • 70% Field 30% Admin dan memahami kondisi di lapangan dengan segala keterbatasannya karena akan tinggal di wilayah pelayanannya.
  • Memiliki kemampuan memfasilitasi yang baik karena akan membangun hubungan dengan berbagai pihak.
  • Kemampuan berkomunikasi serta bahasa lokal daerah di wilayah pelayanan Area Development Program Lombok lebih diutamakan dan kemampuan berkominikasi Bahasa Inggris merupakan nilai tambah.
  • Posisi ini ditempatkan di Mataram untuk Proyek Marvel sebagai staf lokal.

Kebijakan Safeguarding

WVI menerapkan Kebijakan Safeguarding sebagai bentuk komitmen kami untuk melindungi penerima manfaat anak-anak dan orang dewasa. WVI tidak mentolerir segala bentuk kekerasan atau pelecehan terhadap anak-anak atau orang dewasa, termasuk eksploitasi atau pelecehan seksual, baik oleh staf atau orang lain yang berafiliasi dengan WVI. WVI juga berpartisipasi dalam Skema Pengungkapan Pelanggaran Antar-Lembaga (Misconduct Disclosure Scheme/MDS) yang diinisiasi oleh Steering Committee for Humanitarian Response (SCHR).

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer
We build and operate web products used daily by tens of thousands of people across 13 European countries. Treatwell Connect is our SaaS platform for salon and venue management, the tool thousands of salon owners rely on to run their business every day. Following the integration of Salonized, we now have a dedicated QA team and we're shaping it with intention. We've seen firsthand that embedded, proactive QA is what separates reliable releases from reactive firefighting.

We're looking for a senior QA engineer who is passionate about quality as a team discipline: someone who builds automation foundations, runs effective exploratory testing, and shifts how the people around them think about quality, not just how they personally test.

You will be responsible for:

  • Build an automation framework from scratch, starting with API-level coverage of critical end-to-end happy path flows, the ones that must never break in a product shipping multiple times a day.
  • Mentor QA team members into more technical and structured testing practice.
  • Work with developers to build shared ownership of quality across engineering: encourage better unit testing, help them understand what good coverage looks like, and shift quality from a QA concern to a team habit.
  • Run exploratory testing to surface edge cases and failure modes that specs don't anticipate
  • Own feature aftercare: monitor releases in production, track stability, and drive continuous improvement from what you find.
  • Identify gaps that developers and PMs miss and bring them to the table early, contributing to product decisions throughout the cycle, not just at the end.
  • Track QA metrics that matter, bug detection rate, release confidence, post-release defect counts, and own the narrative around what they mean for the product.

Our QA context

Treatwell Connect is a SaaS platform with web and mobile surfaces. The product moves fast, and what breaks has a direct impact on the livelihoods of the beauty & wellness businesses that depend on it every day.

This is a greenfield role with a real mandate. There is no framework to inherit and no years of technical debt to unpick. The starting point is API coverage for the most critical flows, with UI automation following as confidence in the foundation grows.

You will work alongside a junior QA specialist and a mid-level QA analyst, reporting to the QA Team Lead, with engineering and product leadership actively invested in where this function goes.

About you:

  • 5+ years of QA experience with hands-on automation work and structured manual and exploratory testing. You know when each approach is the right tool.
  • You've built automation frameworks before, not just used them. You're fluent in at least one programming language and can make and defend tooling decisions without a spec telling you what to choose.
  • You take satisfaction from shifting how a team thinks about testing, not just from shipping test suites. Quality culture is something you actively build, not something you leave to others.
  • You influence without authority: you bring developers, designers and product closer to quality, and the habits you build outlast your direct involvement.
  • You can articulate risks clearly to engineers, PMs, and non-technical stakeholders, and you're comfortable pushing back when something isn't ready to ship.
  • You want to make the people around you better, and you're patient enough to do it consistently.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools, particularly Datadog. Knowing how to read production signals and connect them to your testing strategy is a meaningful advantage.
  • Experience working across web, mobile, and API surfaces in a single product. Treatwell Connect spans all three, and comfort with that complexity matters.
  • Experience with SQL for data validation, debugging, and exploratory testing. Ability to write queries to trace data flows, verify backend logic and support root cause analysis across distributed systems is a plus

About Treatwell
Hi, we’re Treatwell. Nice to meet you.

We’re a team of 700 passionate and brilliantly talented people across Europe. We’re the industry’s smartest salon management software, all connected to Europe’s leading bookings platform, working with over 50,000 salon partners across 13 countries, processing over 8 million bookings every month. And….breathe.

But we’re not done yet. We’re on an exciting journey to digitally revolutionise the hair and beauty community.

If this excites you, we might just have the role for you.
We’ll treat you with:

  • 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays
  • Monthly €40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too
  • Mental health support through our partnership with Plumm
  • Growth funds for you to develop and grow with your team

Equal Ops

We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their condition.

title: Cloud Database Administrator - Remote (WFH)
description:
About Cognitive:

Cognitive is an IT and software engineering services company dedicated to elevating the quality, speed and delivery of today’s US government healthcare programs. With a wealth of clinical expertise and hands-on experience, our team understands the significant challenges our government clients—and their customers—face every day. This real-world experience equips us to develop IT solutions that seamlessly connect all facets of healthcare delivery. At Cognitive, we’re guiding government agencies to the forefront of technology innovation in healthcare delivery.

Position Overview:

*This position is contingent upon contract award*

The Cloud Database Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, optimization, performance tuning, and security of all database and data platform environments within the CMS Drug Data Processing System (DDPS) and Payment Reconciliation System (PRS). This individual manages the multi-platform data environment including AWS Redshift Serverless, Snowflake, and relational databases supporting DDPS operations, ensuring data integrity, availability, query performance, backup/recovery readiness, and compliance with CMS data governance and security requirements.

This is a remote position; however, Cognitive hires only in the following designated U.S. states based on contract and business requirements: VA, DC, MD, TN, FL, AZ, CO, OR, and TX.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Administer, monitor, and optimize all DDPS/PRS database environments including AWS Redshift Serverless, Snowflake, Amazon Athena query optimization, and relational databases supporting application operations.
  • Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, index management, and workload management across all platforms.
  • Manage database backup, recovery, and high-availability configurations; validate backup integrity and support DR testing and RTO/RPO compliance.
  • Support Databricks workspace administration including cluster management, job scheduling, and notebook/pipeline performance.
  • Develop and maintain database schemas, stored procedures, and data migration scripts supporting application development and legislative implementation work.
  • Ensure all database environments comply with CMS ARS security controls including encryption at rest and in transit, access control, audit logging, and vulnerability remediation timelines.
  • Support database testing usingDBFit/FitNesse; coordinate with the QA Manager on data quality validation and test environment database management.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; 6 or more years in database administration including 3 or more years on cloud data platforms.
  • Hands-on production experience with AWS Redshift Serverless and Snowflake for large-scale data warehousing.
  • Experience with Amazon Athena query optimization and Amazon S3 data lake management.
  • Experience with Databricks cluster and workspace administration.
  • Strong SQL skills for performance tuning, schema development, stored procedures, and data migrations.
  • Experience with database security controls including encryption, IAM-based access, audit logging, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Ability to pass CMS and internal required background checks for public trust.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization making a difference in healthcare IT.
  • Collaborate with innovative and passionate professionals that are there to support you at every turn.
  • Enjoy a supportive work/life balance with the flexibility of a 100% remote company.
  • Benefit from opportunities for growth and development in a dynamic environment.

title: Program Management Stf
description:
Standard Job Description

The Program Manager will lead the end‑to‑end development of digital electronics for the IGNITE edge processing portfolio. A program manager on our team will typically lead one or more CCA or entire box development efforts through technology readiness levels (TRL) 0 to 6+ and Mission Classes A, B, C or D. This role is responsible for defining program strategy, coordinating cross‑functional teams, managing schedules, budgets, and risk, and ensuring that deliverables meet performance, cost, and schedule objectives in support of advanced mission‑critical systems.

Program Leadership – Define, execute, and own the program roadmap for digital electronics hardware, from concept through production.

Cross‑Functional Coordination – Partner with systems engineering, firmware, software, mechanical, test, procurement, and subcontracts teams to align requirements and meet program milestones.

Schedule & Budget Management – Develop and maintain detailed master schedules, resource plans, and budgets; track progress and implement corrective actions as needed.

Risk & Issue Management – Identify technical and programmatic risks, implement mitigation strategies, and communicate status to senior leadership.

Technical Oversight – Provide guidance on architecture, component selection, PCB design, signal integrity, and thermal management; ensure compliance with aerospace standards.

Stakeholder Communication – Prepare and deliver regular status briefings, performance metrics, and executive dashboards.

Supplier & Contract Management – Lead supplier selection, qualification, and performance monitoring for parts, sub‑assemblies, and manufacturing.

Configuration & Change Control – Enforce PLM processes, manage baselines, and control documentation throughout the product life cycle.

Team Development – Mentor junior engineers and program staff; foster a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

Standard Job Description

Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion. Responsible for the cost, schedule and technical performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs. Participates in the negotiation of contract and contract changes. Coordinates the preparation of proposals, business plans, proposal work statements and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss cost, schedule, and technical performance. Establishes design concepts, criteria and engineering efforts for product research, development, integration and test. Develops new business or expands the product line with the customer. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocation of resources or changing contractual specifications. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program from technical, manufacturing and administrative areas. Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelors or higher degree in an Engineering or related discipline
  • Experience in digital electronics or related industry
  • Project Management Experience
  • Demonstrated Control Account Manager (CAM) experience, including managing program budgets, schedules, and resource
  • Demonstrated experience in working with multiple functions and disciplines such as engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain
  • Ability to obtain Top Secret clearance

title: Freelance Agent Evaluation Engineer
description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $40/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

title: Wholesale Supervisor
description:
Job Title: Full Time Wholesale Supervisor

Reports To: Assistant Manager, Distribution Center

FLSA Status: Pay Classification: Non-Exempt Hourly

Pay: $22–$26/hour (Non-Exempt, Hourly)
Schedule: Full-time, flexible during peak seasons

About Shinesty

Shinesty makes clothing that likes to party—the kind that turns heads, sparks conversations, and brings humor into everyday life. We’re fast-growing, well-funded, and on a mission to become the most fun and most loved brand in the world.

We take our work seriously—but not ourselves. If you believe hard work and having fun can (and should) coexist, you’ll fit right in.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Wholesale Supervisor to help lead and scale one of our fastest-growing business channels. This is a hands-on leadership role designed for someone who may be earlier in their career but brings grit, curiosity, and a strong desire to grow.

Because this is a newer role, you’ll have the chance to build processes, create structure, and leave your mark. You’ll work closely with operations, sales, and warehouse teams to ensure our wholesale orders are accurate, on time, and executed at a high level.

If you’re energized by problem-solving, ownership, and being part of something growing fast—this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

As a Wholesale Supervisor, you’ll be responsible for the day-to-day success of Shinesty’s wholesale operations, including:

  • Own and manage daily wholesale workflows using our B2B → DC planning tools
  • Ensure all wholesale orders, transfers, and inventory adjustments are processed accurately and on time
  • Perform root-cause analysis when issues arise and drive solutions forward
  • Communicate proactively with sales and operations teams to resolve priorities quickly
  • Create, document, and train Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized warehouse environment
  • Ensure compliance with Shinesty safety standards and OSHA requirements
  • Maintain wholesale inventory accuracy at 99.99%
  • Lead by example—bringing energy, accountability, and positivity to the team

How You’ll Lead

You’ll supervise and support wholesale operations associates by:

  • Coaching team members on performance, accuracy, and efficiency
  • Training new hires and reinforcing operational standards
  • Managing labor planning, productivity metrics, and quality expectations
  • Providing clear feedback and support to help your team grow

What We’re Looking For

We care more about attitude and potential rather than checking every box.

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Have experience in a fast-paced environment (warehouse, retail, operations, or logistics preferred)
  • Are interested in leadership and developing people
  • Pay strong attention to detail and take pride in accuracy
  • Can adapt quickly when priorities change
  • Show up on time, ready to work, and ready to learn
  • Approach problems with a solutions-first mindset
  • Are comfortable using technology, including Excel and handheld devices

Our Values (We Live These Daily)

  • Be Hungry
  • Be Weird
  • Break Boundaries
  • Be N.I.C.E.
  • Pleasure the Customer

Shinesty is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Requirements

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • A combination of administrative and on-the-warehouse-floor work
  • Use of tablets, scanners, pallet jacks, forklifts, and standard office equipment
  • Standing for extended periods, lifting, reaching, and operating warehouse machinery
  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends or holidays during peak seasons
  • Intermediate Microsoft Office experience, specifically Excel
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work in both independent and team settings
  • Show up for your shifts, on time.
  • Operate from a solutions-focused mindset.
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced and frequently changing environment.
  • Be the hardest working, most bad-ass, chillest of the wiliest person in your class.
  • Typical shift is M-F 8 am to 430pm but does require flexibility to adapt to peak season and major holidays.

Benefits

Perks & Benefits

  • Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Incredible employee discount (at or below cost)
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Real growth opportunities in a rapidly scaling company

title: Supervisor
description:
Diversity matters
We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

Who we are
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.

The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.

The role
Supervisors play a vital role in our team, consistently delivering exceptional customer service and crafting standout experiences throughout the year. You’ll have a genuine passion for connecting with customers and a talent for bringing out the best in their team. As a Supervisor, you lead the charge in fostering a positive atmosphere on the shop floor, collaborating seamlessly with your colleagues to achieve shared goals, and cultivating an environment that encourages continuous development within your team.

Beyond just the basics of communication, you'll be the go-to for keeping the info flowing smoothly throughout the store. Team up with your colleagues, the store manager, and neighboring stores, maintaining an open and friendly communication flow that significantly contributes to the team's success on the shop floor.

In your role as a Supervisor, your natural leadership shines through as you handle conversations with finesse, set and manage expectations, and provide unwavering support to your team. Balancing the needs of the business while keeping team morale high is the key to your success in this dynamic and influential position.

Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.

Key Information

Contract Type: Part Time, Fixed Term (12 months)

Hours available: 20 hours per week

Application Deadline: 23:59 Wednesday 9th September 2026

Interview Date: Saturday 19th, Sunday 20th, Saturday 26th or Sunday 27th September.

Start Date: From 28th September 2026.


Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.
  • Lead and motivate the sales team to deliver exceptional customer service by providing regular coaching, feedback, and encouragement, helping them improve their product knowledge and sales skills.
  • Engage with customers by offering a warm welcome, asking open-ended questions to understand their needs, and providing tailored product recommendations to create a memorable shopping experience.
  • Maintain a clean, visually appealing, and well-organized shop floor by ensuring displays follow guidelines, adjusting to seasonal trends, and keeping shelves well-stocked.
  • Support the store manager in achieving sales targets through team motivation, creative approaches to drive performance (like check-ins or shop floor competitions), and actively seeking opportunities to exceed goals.
  • Organise and contribute to in-store events, customer celebrations, and external outreach to enhance the customer experience and drive business growth, while ensuring that the team is trained to confidently host these events.
  • Provide training, feedback, and development for team members to improve their skills, foster a collaborative environment, and support the recruitment and onboarding of new staff.
  • Lead the store effectively in the absence of the store manager by ensuring smooth daily operations, maintaining high standards, and maximising sales throughout all opening hours.
  • Ensure health and safety standards are followed by maintaining a safe work environment, addressing any issues promptly, and supporting overall store compliance.
  • Seek opportunities for personal development through training sessions, coaching from management, and connecting with other leaders, aiming to continuously enhance skills and contribute ideas to improve the shop floor experience.

Customer Service: Embrace a genuine love for delivering outstanding customer service, inspiring your team to shine and provide that 5-star experience. Our stores are all about creating a haven of kindness, aiming to make our customers' days unforgettable. As a Supervisor, you play a vital role in bringing this to life.

Management Skills: Navigate tricky conversations with finesse, set and manage expectations, and be the backbone of support for your team. As a Supervisor, you're the one balancing the business needs while keeping the team's spirits high and energised.

Teamwork: Be the beacon of positivity on the shop floor, working alongside your team to achieve your collective goals. and fostering a supportive work environment through continuous team growth. Your role as a Supervisor is all about making teamwork feel like second nature.

Communication: Weave effective verbal communication skills into your daily routine, spreading the word throughout the store and collaborating seamlessly with retailers, your manager, and neighbouring stores. As a Supervisor, keeping the communication flow open and respectful is the secret for success on the shop floor.

title: India - Senior Data Engineer (Contractual Remote Opportunity)
description:
About Inchcape Shipping Services

At Inchcape, our vision is to have a connected world, in which our customers trade successfully and make better decisions in every port, everywhere. We use technology and our global network to help our partners connect to a smoother, smarter ocean.

Inchcape combines its worldwide infrastructure with local expertise through our global network of over 250 proprietary offices, across 70 countries and a team of more than 3,000 committed professionals. Our diverse global customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors as well as naval, government and intergovernmental organizations.

We have an ambitious growth model and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.

Note: This role is on a contract basis & the duration of contract will be 3-4 months .It can be extendable as per the business need.

Main Purpose of Job

The Senior Data Engineer designs, builds and maintains the data ingestion and transformation pipelines that populate Inchcape’s central data platforms. This role ingests raw data from diverse systems, curates the bronze and silver layers of the medallion architecture, ensures data quality and performance, and delivers reliable, reusable datasets for modelling, analysis, reporting and BI.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from ERP, CRM, operational, financial, and third‑party sources into the Microsoft Fabric Platform - Lakehouse (OneLake) using Delta Lake/Parquet.
  • Implement data quality standards and controls, incremental loading, CDC and error handling to ensure reliability and correctness.
  • Create bronze tables, curated Silver and gold tables by transforming, cleansing and conforming raw data, document lineage and transformations.
  • Optimise performance through partitioning, clustering and tuning of MS Fabric, SQL and Spark workloads, monitor pipeline health and costs.
  • Collaborate with Data Architects, Modellers and Data BAs to design schemas, naming conventions and integration patterns to ensure business self-service enablement through Gold data.
  • Build reusable components, templates and automation scripts using Fabric Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks or equivalent tools.
  • Maintain metadata and sensitivity labels via Purview, ensure proper access controls and compliance.
  • Research and evaluate new features and patterns in Microsoft Fabric and make recommendations for adoption, enabling an AI-driven data strategy.
  • Introduce the most economic, optimised technique in the data integration space to reduce total operational cost.
  • Ensure NFR requirements like resilience, availability and security standards are applied as per agreed NFR metrics.

Key Deliverables

  • Automated, documented ingestion pipelines with monitoring and alerting.
  • High‑quality conforming bronze, silver and gold data assets that are ready for self-service.
  • Performance benchmarks and tuning reports demonstrating efficient resource usage.
  • Contribution to ingestion templates, best practice guides and knowledge sharing.
  • Low-Level Designs for data pipelines and other data integration-related assets.

Essential

  • 8+ years in data engineering or data integration roles, working with SQL, Python and or Scala.
  • Experience of ETL/ELT patterns, CDC, incremental loading and data warehousing principles using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Practical experience with Delta Lake, Lakehouse/Medallion architecture and cloud data platforms (Azure and AWS).
  • Proficient in building pipelines with tools like MS Fabric Dataflows Gen2, Spark/SQL notebooks or equivalent.
  • Experienced in data quality frameworks and monitoring/observability tools.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and communicate technical concepts to non‑engineers.

Desirable

  • Experience with streaming data (Kafka, Event Hubs) or real‑time ingestion.
  • Knowledge of master data management and data governance practices.
  • Familiarity with version control and CI/CD for data pipelines.
  • Experience in, and assisted in, the implementation of governance, controls, and standards.
  • Any Shipping or Maritime experience
  • Big Data Ecosystem prior experience is a plus.

Educational & Professional Qualification:

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline.
  • Certification in Azure Data Engineering is a MUST.

Desirable

  • Certifications in AWS cloud data platform or other data platform.

Plus much more!

Why Inchcape Shipping Services?

We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training, and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills, and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry.

Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these:

Global Perspective - We connect the world and see the bigger picture.
The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships.
Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.

Inchcape is an Equal Opportunities Employer - equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of everything we do. Working in a diverse society, we recognise that our customers, colleagues, and contractors are central to our success.

Additional Information:

Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation, depending upon your geographical location.

To protect the interests of all parties, Inchcape will not accept unsolicited or speculative resumes from recruitment agencies and will not be responsible for any fees associated with them.
