title: Equipment Technician
description:
Primary Function of Position

Equipment technicians are responsible for directly supporting and improving manufacturing lines to meet production goals. Typical activities include operating, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining manufacturing equipment including complex automation. Duties include working in different disciplines, such as electrical, mechanical and computer engineering. The equipment technician’s work pattern will mirror production shift schedules.

Essential Job Duties

  • Perform first-response troubleshooting to correct equipment and process issues with objective to maximize line uptime.
  • Apply experience and knowledge to optimize equipment for continuously improve maintainability, reliability, and availability of equipment.
  • Participate in Safety commission when required and/or safety training.
  • Escalates any safety issues with supervisor or manager.
  • Follows 5S methodology on his areas.
  • Escalates excessive consumption of spare parts.
  • Reports any safety device on equipment that is faulty or is suspicious of been damaged.
  • Perform installation, repair and upkeep services for a variety of equipment in the fields of mechanics and electronics.
  • Carry out routine scheduled equipment service and maintenance.
  • Complete formal documentation (in SAP) regarding equipment events: Issue owner assigned (IOA), Assess Risk to parts Made prior to Event (PDSP) tasks under Equipment Event (EE) process. (Engineer will perform final approval).
  • Gather and communicate data on main offenders and provide feedback to Equipment Engineer and/or Supervisor to make improvements for better machine performance.
  • Communicate and assist engineering team to inform, prioritize, plan and implement required improvements.
  • Assist engineering in testing and evaluating equipment updates.
  • Seek better and more suitable technologies for improving production processes.
  • Assisting equipment engineers in performing qualification activities (IQOQPQ) when required.
  • Dealing with emergency/unscheduled problems and repairs of equipment.
  • Ensure continuous line-side coverage of the machinery and equipment in case of breakdowns.
  • Update Min/Max quantities for critical spare parts as needed.
  • Train set up technicians as required.
  • Assembling new equipment and fixtures.
  • Replace faulty components in machinery or equipment according to documentation or engineering instructions.
  • Submit purchase orders of spare parts.
  • Shipping of equipment to vendors for failure analysis and/or repair.
  • Assembly of 3D printed parts.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • English 30% read, written and spoken.
  • Demonstrated mechanical and electronics aptitude.
  • Demonstrated experience in troubleshooting electronic/mechanical equipment.
  • Blueprint reading and interpretation is a must.
  • Knowledge and experience in use of special mechanical, electronics and measuring equipment.
  • CAD proficiency preferable
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Programs.
  • Experience in installation, setup and operation of computers.
  • Experience in Mechanical fixtures and tools, such as presses, tools, thread extractors, calipers, micrometers, hand and power tools.
  • Experience in Pneumatics, knowledge of electro valves, cylinders, gauges, pneumatic connections.
  • Experience in Electronics, knowledge of basic components like relays, resistors, capacitors, sensors and electronic measurement tools such as multimeter, soldering iron, soldering extractor, crimpers.

Required Education and Training

  • Minimum Technical certificate in Technical Electronics, Mechanics or similar.
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, mechatronics or equivalent engineering field is a plus.
  • Travel: Not required but raining travel can be required due to new projects (5%).

Working Conditions

  • None

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience in Medical company is desirable to have.
  • Experience in troubleshooting of Automated equipment or PLC based is a plus

title: Software Developer IV
description:
Job Description:

Title: Software Developer IV

Location: Remote – Canada

Reports to: Software Engineering Manager

Vacancy: Existing vacancy

The Role:

JD Power is looking for a senior data engineer with excellent quantitative and analytical skills who can combine multiple data sources to solve complex challenges around vehicle valuations, market readiness, and customer purchase decisions. You'll work hands-on with quantitative data to create new capabilities and improve existing ones. Beyond day-to-day engineering, you'll be a strategic technical advisor, translating complex data problems into business solutions and mentoring the next generation of data engineers.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

We build data products that solve critical problems for the auto industry. Every data engineer works on production initiatives that directly impact new and existing products. In this role, you'll own end-to-end responsibility for business-critical projects, ensure technical excellence across the team, and drive organizational capability through knowledge transfer and mentorship.

What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:

Core Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Daily immersion in automotive industry data, with deep expertise in complex business rules and data management

  • Own full development lifecycle—architecture, development, testing, and bug resolution—for business-critical data initiatives

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define data requirements and translate business problems into technical solutions

  • Engineer robust, extensible data pipelines using modern cloud technologies (Snowflake, DATAPROC, AIRFLOW, Cloud Composer, Big Query)

  • Design, troubleshoot, and execute repeatable data processes; identify bottlenecks and optimize for efficiency and reliability

  • Bridge technical and business teams: analyze complex issues and communicate findings in terms business leadership understands

  • Enforce engineering best practices and proactively identify security vulnerabilities across the team

  • Mentor junior engineers on new technologies, processes, and industry domain knowledge

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives across Consulting, New Product Development, Data, and Engineering teams

Qualifications of this Role:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, Operations Research, Quantitative Marketing, Finance, Engineering, or similar field

  • 6+ years of full-time quantitative analytics and data engineering experience

  • Expert in SQL and Python; proficiency in modern cloud data platforms (GCP Bigquery, Snowflake)

  • Highly skilled in extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes with demonstrated efficiency and accuracy outcomes

  • Hands-on experience with orchestration tools (AIRFLOW, Cloud Composer) and distributed computing (DATAPROC)

  • Proven ability to integrate complex, multi-source data sets with multiple dimensions and layers of complexity

  • Track record of resolving data quality issues creatively and effectively; strong judgment to flag anomalies and inconsistencies

  • Ability to translate technical analysis into clear business insights; effective communicator in written and verbal formats

  • Subject matter expertise or demonstrated ability to quickly develop deep domain knowledge in industry-specific business rules and processes

AI-Assisted Development

  • Proficient with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) and able to judge when to accept, edit, or reject generated output

  • Skilled at providing effective context — codebase conventions, requirements, constraints — to produce production-quality results

  • Experience using AI to accelerate test authoring, documentation, and routine refactoring

  • Aware of AI tool limitations: hallucinated APIs, outdated patterns, security pitfalls in generated code, and the need for human verification before merge

Personal Attributes

  • Self-directed and detail-oriented, able to take ownership of work from requirements through release

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, comfortable working across technical and business stakeholders

  • Supports the growth of other team members through peer reviews, pairing, and mentorship

The Hiring Manager says:

The Pricing & Valuation team is a highly strategic area for J.D. Power. title: 2027 Executive Associate Program - Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
Overview:

The Executive Associate Program is designed for 2nd year MBA students who seek to accelerate their career within M&T Bank. Program hires will undergo an immersive leadership experience designed to develop leadership competencies and strategic capabilities. Throughout the first year, the incoming cohort will be introduced to Program alumni, Bank-wide leadership, and collaborate with peers to drive change to support the vision and goals of the Bank.

Department Overview
The Finance organization plays a critical role in helping M&T Bank achieve its strategic objectives by providing financial insight, performance analysis, and decision support across the enterprise. Through financial planning, forecasting, business performance management, and strategic analysis, the team partners with senior leaders to evaluate opportunities, allocate resources, and drive long-term growth.


The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Business Line Finance teams serve as trusted advisors to executive leadership, translating financial results into actionable insights that support business decisions. By partnering across the organization, the team helps leaders understand performance drivers, assess investment opportunities, measure progress against strategic goals, and ensure the efficient deployment of capital and resources.
As an Executive Associate within FP&A, you’ll support finance leadership by providing analytical, strategic, and project support related to business planning, financial performance, and enterprise priorities.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Support the development and execution of the Bank’s annual strategic planning process, including financial target setting, performance measurement, and enterprise reporting.

  • Conduct financial, operational, and strategic analyses to inform business decisions, capital allocation, and long-term growth objectives.

  • Partner with Finance leaders and business line stakeholders to evaluate business performance, profitability trends, and return on investment opportunities.

  • Assist in preparing materials, analyses, and recommendations for senior leadership forums, including the Strategic Investment Committee (SIC) and Resource Allocation Committee (RAC).

  • Assess business cases for major strategic initiatives by validating assumptions, analyzing costs and benefits, and identifying key risks and opportunities.

  • Support enterprise investment governance processes by tracking initiative performance, resource utilization, and expected business outcomes.

  • Contribute to the implementation and optimization of profitability measurement tools and reporting capabilities across business units and product lines.

  • Analyze product, client, and business segment profitability to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and improved financial performance.

  • Support the monthly earnings forecasting process by gathering financial inputs, validating assumptions, preparing analyses, and developing leadership reporting materials.

  • Synthesize complex financial and operational information into clear presentations and recommendations for executive leadership.

  • Collaborate with senior leaders across Finance and business lines to support strategic initiatives, special projects, and enterprise priorities.

  • Develop executive-level presentations, dashboards, and briefing materials that facilitate strategic decision-making.

  • Conduct research and benchmarking to evaluate industry trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities impacting the Bank's financial performance.

Complete project/management related assignments in field of expertise within the Executive Associate Program.

None

Completed MBA from an accredited business school.

Minimum of 3 years’ professional work experience

Demonstrated leadership potential, as evidenced through previous work experience, extracurricular activities, or community involvement
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Excellent interpersonal skills

Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization
Strong analytical skills

Strong problem-solving skills to think strategically and critically analyze complex business challenges
Strong project management skills to handle multiple priorities and deadlines
Work visa sponsorship not offered for this role

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in Finance, Treasury, Accounting, or related function; understanding and working knowledge of Financial statements

  • Experienced or expert knowledge of Excel and PPT

  • Understanding of leveraging AI tools to support business initiatives

  • Ability to learn and adapt to new systems and technical tools to support research and analysis

  • Ability to proactively identify opportunities and solve complex business problems

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders through presentations, executive summaries, case competitions, consulting projects, leadership roles, or professional work experience.

  • Strong presentation skills and the ability to tailor messages to executive audiences

title: Sr. Analyst, Project Management - EMRge Custom
description:
About Ovative Group:

Ovative Group is an independent, full-funnel media, measurement, and creative firm. Leveraging our deep industry expertise, we help brands like Best Buy, Domino's, American Eagle, The Home Depot, Post, Disney, Tumi, Michael Kors, Boost Mobile, and UnitedHealth Group transform their media and measurement programs. The result? Profitable growth that speaks for itself.

At Ovative, we don't just track data, we redefine success. How do we do it? Our proprietary MarTech platform, EMRge helps businesses transform marketing into a driver of sustainable growth. Powered by Enterprise Marketing Return (EMR), our differentiated approach to holistic media buying, planning, and measurement, EMRge is the first MarTech platform to measure businesses holistically. We're all about raising the bar every day, and it shows. Our work has been recognized by organizations like Digiday, Google, Inc. 5000, USA Today, and Search Engine Land.

About the Role:

EMRge Custom is a cross-functional Ovative team of Data Science (DS) and Data Engineering (DE) resources that delivers bespoke client work, innovation and platform partnerships, and consultative support for Edge Builders (our self-service builder role). The team exists to help Ovative respond nimbly to client and internal needs that fall outside the scope of standard EMRge product development and client delivery.

As Technical Project Manager for EMRge Custom, you will own project management and intake coordination across all four of the team’s work areas — Custom MMM & Analytics, Innovation & Partnership, Team Maintenance, and Edge Builder Support. You are the connective tissue between Go to Market (GTM), DS and DE Tech Directors, Measurement & Technology Service (MTS) leaders, client account teams, and broader organizational stakeholders. You will ensure work moves from intake to delivery on time, on scope, and with the right people informed at every step.

You will report to the Sr. Manager of EMRge Client Operations and partner day-to-day with the DS Tech Director, DE Tech Director, and where relevant the GTM team to translate business requirements into executable work. This is an execution-oriented role that requires strong adaptive organizational instincts, clear communication under ambiguity, confidence to manage prioritization decisions, and ability to drive organizational change of new processes across stakeholders.

Role Responsibilities of a Sr. Analyst, Project Management:

Intake & Prioritization

  • Develop and Own the Intake Process: Build and manage the intake process for EMRge Custom, establishing a clear, structured way for client teams and Edge builders to submit requests, with defined criteria for how work is triaged, scoped, and sequenced across the team's four work areas. Build in partnership with Edge Builder Product Owner.

  • Prioritize Work Across Client Engagements: Maintain a holistic view of all active and incoming contracted work, sequencing priorities across Custom MMM & Analytics, Innovation & Partnership, Team Maintenance, and Edge Builder Support, surfacing tradeoffs and capacity conflicts to leadership proactively.

  • Translate Requests into Executable Work: Partner with DS and DE Tech Directors to convert incoming requests into well-scoped, clearly defined work items, including problem framing, acceptance conditions, and resource requirements, applying agile best practices to break work into discrete, deliverable increments that reduce ambiguity and enable technical resources to move quickly.

Timeline & Delivery Management

  • Define and Manage Timelines: Collaborate with stakeholders to establish clear project timelines, ensuring work is reflected accurately across active engagements. Monitor project progress to keep client work on track, proactively managing scope changes with thorough communication to all stakeholders.

  • Own Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders on timeline, status, and deliverables, communicating clearly and consistently across audiences.

  • Manage Capacity and Risk: Maintain real-time visibility across DS and DE workstreams, proactively identifying resourcing constraints, scope risks, and blockers, and surfacing them to the DS and DE Tech Directors and leadership before they impact delivery.

  • Leverage AI to Drive Operational Efficiency: Actively use AI tools to accelerate the operational demands of the role, including synthesizing project status across workstreams, drafting stakeholder communications, maintaining documentation, and surfacing patterns in intake and capacity data that inform prioritization decisions.

Change Management & Documentation

  • Lead Change Management: Drive change management efforts for client-related processes, ensuring smooth transitions and clear communication to all affected parties across DS, DE, and stakeholder teams.

  • Own Engagement Documentation: Document engagement scope, outputs, and maintenance requirements at the close of each engagement to support continuity and prevent undocumented technical debt from accumulating.

  • Maintain Team Confluence: Maintain Confluence/JIRA documentation for EMRge Custom, keeping team-level process, operating model, and engagement records current and accessible to the broader organization.

Requirements:

  • 2-3+ years of experience in project management, program management, or a related coordination role, with at least 1 years working directly alongside technical teams (Data Science, Data Engineering, or similar).

  • Demonstrated experience managing intake, prioritization, and delivery tracking for technical work — including triaging requests, sequencing competing priorities, and maintaining backlog clarity in any project management or work management tool (e.g., Confueunce, Jira, Clickup, or similar).

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience communicating project status, scope, and risk to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage scope boundaries and make prioritization calls independently, without requiring escalation for routine decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to create and maintain clear, structured documentation across the project lifecycle — including scope definitions, status updates, engagement outputs, and process changes — ensuring information is accessible, accurate, and usable by technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to synthesize complex technical work into clear, plain-language updates for clients and leadership.

  • Demonstrated experience with or active curiosity toward AI tools, with a mindset toward applying them to improve the quality and efficiency of day-to-day work.

Preferred

  • Background in marketing measurement, media analytics, or adjacent fields (e.g., attribution, incrementality testing, or marketing mix modeling).

  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Databricks, BigQuery, or similar environments — not at an implementation level, but sufficient to follow technical conversations and flag risks.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams with competing priorities across DS and DE functions.

  • Prior experience in a consulting or client services environment where stakeholder relationship management is central to the role.

  • Comfort working in Kanban or iterative delivery environments where methodology, tooling, and process are simultaneously evolving.

  • Experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, JSM, Confluence) preferred, but not required.

Pay Transparency

At Ovative, we offer a transparent view into three core components of your total compensation package: Base Salary, Annual Bonus, and Benefits. The salary range for this position below is inclusive of an annual bonus. Actual offers are made with consideration for relevant experience and anticipated impact. Additional benefits information is provided below.

For our Sr. Analyst positions, our compensation ranges from $75,000 to $93,000, which is inclusive of a 15% bonus.

Benefits of Working at Ovative Group:

We provide strong, competitive, holistic benefits that understand the importance of your life inside and out of work.

Culture:

Culture matters and we’ve been recognized as a Top Workplace for ten years running because of it. We demand trust and transparency from each other. We believe in doing the hard and complicated work others put off. We’re open in communication and floor plan. We’re flat – our interns sit next to VPs, our analysts work closely with senior leaders, and our CEO interacts with every single person daily. Put together, these elements help foster an environment where smart people can support each other in performing to their highest potential.

Ovative is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can participate and thrive. We do not tolerate discrimination of any kind, including on the basis of race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. Our policies reflect this commitment—for example, our medical leave benefits are inclusive of same-sex partners, ensuring equitable care and support for all families.

Compensation and Insurance:

We strive to hire and retain the best talent. Paying fair, competitive compensation, with a large bonus incentive, and phenomenal health insurance is an important part of this mix.

We’re rewarded fairly and when the company performs well, we all benefit.

Tangible amenities we enjoy:

  • Access to all office spaces in MSP, NYC, and CHI

  • Frequent, paid travel to our Minneapolis headquarters for company events, team events, and in-person collaboration with teams

  • Generous paid vacation policy

  • 401k match program

  • Top-notch health insurance options, inclusive of same sex partners

  • Family formation benefits including reimbursement options for fertility, pregnancy, and parenting needs

  • Monthly stipend for your mobile phone and data plan

  • Sabbatical program

  • Charitable giving via our time and a financial match program

  • Shenanigan’s Day

Working at Ovative won’t be easy, but if you like getting your hands dirty, driving results, and being surrounded by the best talent, it’ll be the most rewarding job you’ll ever have. If you think you can make us better, we want to hear from you!

title: Backend Engineering Intern
description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $35–$50 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a backend engineering internship on the systems that carry real product workflows. Candidate data arrives messy and at volume, has to be modelled well enough to search and score against, and then has to move reliably through jobs, integrations, and APIs that other parts of the product depend on. You will build and extend those systems, and you will be the one who finds out when they are wrong.

The work is a good fit for someone who enjoys correctness and reliability: designing a schema that will still make sense in six months, making a background job idempotent, or tracing a bad record back through three services to its source. Because the team is small, you will own services rather than tickets, and your work will be in production quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Build and extend backend services, APIs, and the data models behind them.
  • Design and maintain database schemas that support search, scoring, and reporting.
  • Build background jobs and integrations, and make them reliable enough to run unattended.
  • Investigate data quality and correctness issues, and fix them at the source.
  • Write code other engineers can read and extend, and review theirs.

Requirements

  • Strong programming fundamentals in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or a similar language.
  • Comfort learning backend systems, APIs, databases, and data modelling.
  • Interest in building reliable systems that support real product workflows.
  • Has shipped meaningful work before, whether side projects, class projects, open-source contributions, or a prior internship.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.

title: Beauty and Wellness Consultant
description:

Maximizes sales and brand awareness by providing exceptional customer care to all customers in a friendly, efficient, and professional manner; gives impartial, personalized, expertise and advice regardless of brand and budget. Demonstrates a passion for beauty and wellness and provides inspirational beauty knowledge and know-how. Operations

  • Models and shares behavior with other Beauty and Wellness Consultants; provides training and assistance to new Beauty and Wellness Consultants.
  • Works collaboratively with Store Leadership to review goals and maintain product knowledge.

About Walgreens
Founded in 1901, Walgreens () proudly serves more than 9 million customers and patients each day across its approximately 8,000 stores throughout the U.S. and Puerto Rico. Walgreens has approximately 211,000 team members, including roughly 85,000 healthcare service providers, and is committed to being the first choice for pharmacy, retail and health services, building trusted relationships that create healthier futures for customers, patients, team members and communities.

Basic Qualifications
  • High School Diploma/GED and at least one year of experience working in a retail sales environment that required meeting a defined sales goal OR at least one year of experience proactively selling beauty or cosmetic products and providing customer care
  • Experience in developing ways to accomplish goals with little or no supervision, depending on oneself to complete objectives and determining when escalation of issues is necessary
  • Knowledge of products and brands in order to engage and meet the needs of the customer.
  • Experience building and maintaining relationships within a team.
  • Basic level PC/tablet skills.
  • Requires willingness to work flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Must be fluent in reading, writing and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)


Preferred Qualifications

title: Director, Data Driven Leadership Middle Schools
description:
The Director of Data Driven Leadership, Middle Schools requires deep knowledge of data-driven instruction, data analysis, progress monitoring, curriculum and instruction, and middle school academic systems to play a critical role in advancing KIPP Texas’ academic priorities. This role is responsible for driving improved student results across middle schools, including academic growth and achievement, STAAR performance, grade-level mastery, strong academic independence, and successful transition to high school. The role serves as a key lever in strengthening academic systems and ensuring schools have the clarity, support, and strategic direction needed to accelerate readiness for high school success and close the achievement gap.

The Director of Data Driven Leadership, Middle Schools is responsible for ensuring KIPP Texas and its individual cities take a strategic approach to reaching academic goals by engaging with regional and school leaders in professional dialogue about best practices in order to improve and accelerate student achievement through quality curriculum and instruction. With a strong focus on middle school success indicators, including academic growth, STAAR performance, grade-level mastery, and high school readiness. This role consistently demonstrates expertise in data-driven instruction, data analysis, progress monitoring, and curriculum and instruction to improve student results, strengthen accountability, and drive sustained academic excellence across middle schools.

You know you are successful if:

  • Regions and schools are implementing effective progress monitoring systems

  • Regions and schools are driving towards rigorous, multi-year targets as well as meeting baseline metrics for a healthy school

  • School and regional leaders are using data proactively to make instructional decisions and improve student outcomes

  • Academic leadership has clear, timely, and actionable insights that support decision-making

Role Responsibilities

Data Driven Leadership and Coaching

  • Lead a culture that recognizes data use as a tool for continuous improvement and decision-making across middle schools

  • Coach regional leaders, middle school leaders, and key stakeholders on how to analyze data, identify performance gaps, diagnose root causes, and take action to improve student achievement, academic rigor, and high school readiness outcomes

  • Support leaders in effectively presenting data reports to teachers, families, and staff to build shared ownership and accountability for outcomes

  • Ensure data conversations lead to clear instructional adjustments and measurable improvements across middle schools

Accountability Aligned Strategy

  • Provide guidance and co-create strategies for the portfolio of middle schools, grounded in accountability and designed to increase student growth, achievement, academic rigor, and readiness for high school success

  • Develop annual goals, major milestones, and success metrics that create clarity across all levels of the organization

  • Ensure strategies are aligned to state accountability systems, internal academic priorities, and long-term student achievement outcomes, including STAAR performance, Algebra readiness, and high school readiness goals

  • Collaborate with schools translate high-level goals into specific actions that drive execution and improve student results

Academic Insights

  • Responsible for conducting ongoing data analysis and creating custom data visualizations and reports to identify strengths and opportunities across middle school performance indicators

  • Analyze both quantitative and qualitative data across student, teacher, leader, and school-level performance indicators

  • Make bold recommendations based on data and provide insights to KIPP Texas leaders on a recurring basis (e.g., weekly)

  • Use data storytelling to clearly communicate findings and drive strategic decision-making

Progress Monitor Top Metrics

  • Create and inform the creation of systems and structures to progress monitor metrics to ensure KIPP Texas middle schools are on track to meet and exceed academic goals

  • Establish routines for regular review of leading indicators, outputs, and outcome metrics across schools and regions

  • Ensure leaders have the tools, systems, and visibility needed to monitor progress toward academic achievement, STAAR performance, and high school readiness goals

  • Identify barriers early and support solutions that improve execution and student outcomes

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience required
  • Master’s degree preferred

Competency and skills

  • Strategic thinker with strong judgment and the ability to prioritize mission-critical work

  • Exceptional data analysis skills with the ability to interpret trends, identify root causes, and translate findings into action

  • Strong understanding of foundational statistics and data-driven decision-making

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences

  • Skilled in influencing, coaching, and leading through relationships rather than direct authority

  • Strong project management and execution skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • High level of ownership, initiative, and problem-solving in complex environments

  • Results-driven with a strong focus on accountability, outcomes, and continuous improvement

  • Collaborative and relationship-oriented with the ability to build trust across diverse stakeholders

  • Deep cultural competence and commitment to educational equity and student achievement

What We Bring to the Table

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with coverage options for employees and their families.

  • Competitive vacation and flexible paid time off (PTO) policies.

  • Paid family leave.

  • Flexible spending account or high-yield HSA.

  • Employee assistance programs.

  • KIPP also offers the following employee-paid benefits: legal plans, LifeLock identity protection, life insurance and disability insurance.

Physical Requirements

  • The person in this position needs to be able to move about inside and outside the school throughout the workday.

  • The candidate is expected to attend conferences, meetings and training sessions both virtually and in person within the Region.

Additional Requirements

  • Reliable transportation is needed for travel between campuses

  • Ability to maintain emotional control under stress.

  • Work with frequent interruptions.

Work Environment

  • Hybrid work - Reports to the central office or schools three days a week

Travel Requirements

  • Regular Travel: Regular travel to school sites, regional offices or external locations for professional learning, meetings and other work related activities. Travel frequency may increase based on time of year.

title: Graduate Regulatory Officer
description:
Job Purpose

Join the Technical Services Regulatory Team within Rentokil Initial’s Marketing and Innovation (M&I) Function. In this role, you will support technical and commercial compliance for chemical products and services across Rentokil Initial’s global business activities. Your primary focus will be to maintain chemical regulatory compliance, execute swift corrective actions when non-compliance is identified, ensure accurate product safety and labelling, and support product registration and launch workflows across international markets.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • Regulatory Risk & Compliance Management: Assist in protecting Rentokil Initial from commercial and technical risks associated with national and international chemical regulations and directives.
  • Corrective Action Execution: Help implement urgent corrective actions across Rentokil Initial businesses to mitigate identified regulatory risk exposures promptly.
  • Technical & Documentation Support: Draft and review Safety Data Sheets (SDS), product classifications, product labels, and packaging specifications in compliance with global standards.
  • Product Registration & Market Entry: Support the end-to-end process of obtaining, updating, and maintaining chemical product registrations to enable smooth market introduction of new products.
  • Database & Systems Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date product safety records and compliance data within company regulatory systems and software (e.g., LISAM).

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (BSc) or higher in Chemistry, Toxicology, Environmental Science, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Foundational understanding of global chemical regulatory frameworks covering registration, hazard classification, chemical safety, transport (ADR/IMDG/IATA), and waste disposal.
  • Technical Systems: Proficiency with chemical regulatory software and databases (experience with LISAM SDS software is highly desirable).
  • Data Analysis & Quality Focus: Strong analytical skills, meticulous attention to detail, and a structured, process-driven approach to complex problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in additional European languages is a strong advantage.

Key Personal Attributes

  • Collaborative & Ethical: A team-oriented professional with sound judgment, high integrity, and commitment to corporate ethics.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional global teams, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Creative and diplomatic approach to overcoming technical, supply chain, and compliance challenges without compromising safety standards.
  • Customer-Centric & Organized: Service-focused ethic with disciplined time management to consistently meet tight regulatory deadlines.

title: Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist
description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

title: Escrow Officer Representative - Lexington, KY
description:
What you’ll do:

You are the key to home ownership. As an escrow officer, you’re the human link between our process and people. You’re there at the beginning, reviewing contracts and following instructions. You’re there in the middle, ensuring that all the associated paperwork is completed efficiently and accurately. You’re working with agents and their clients to keep the process moving forward, verifying that titles are clean, taxes are paid, and loans are funded. Finally, you’re there at the end, to assure that no funds or property will change hands until all terms have been carried to completion.


Who you are:

  • Trusted consultant, maintaining a positive, can-do attitude that gives agents and homebuyers alike the confidence that their transaction is in reliable, good hands and will be completed on time.
  • Problem solver, using your industry knowledge to identify potential issues; recognizing what’s wrong, knowing how to fix it, and avoiding unnecessary delays.
  • Constant learner, staying on top of changing rules and regulations to avoid setbacks and enable transactions to close on time.
  • People reader, recognizing and adapting to an agent’s or homebuyer’s personality and mood to make them feel comfortable, even when delivering bad news; showing empathy to ease their frustration and give them confidence that you’re in their corner.
  • Multi-tasker, highly organized, being able to work a large number of contracts with numerous agents, buyers, and sellers simultaneously under deadline pressure.

Your responsibilities:

  • Jack – or Jill – of all trades: Knowing the intricacies of the contract from beginning to end, ensuring that it is closed in a timely, efficient, and error-free manner.
  • Devoted to detail: Verifying all paperwork is complete so that escrow closes on time and correctly.
  • Following the money: Working with lenders and underwriters to ensure that all the I’s are dotted and T’s are crossed to fund and complete transactions.
  • Relationship building: Establishing and maintaining relationships with essential industry players – agents, attorneys, lenders, surveyors, and government agencies – that enable you to smoothly manage transactions.
  • Business builder: Reaching out to new agents, earning their confidence and trust, and creating opportunities to market our business; retaining agents by providing them with white-glove service.
  • Talent builder: Training escrow assistants to open opportunities for advancement; delegating, auditing work, answering questions, and giving direction.
  • Sealing the deal: Being present at closing and making it a positive, memorable experience for agents and buyers.

Qualifications:

What you must have:

  • Experience: Two to three years of experience in escrow, real estate, mortgage, banking, insurance, legal support, or other transaction‑ or documentation‑heavy roles. Candidates with front‑ and back‑end workflow experience in any regulated or process‑driven environment are encouraged to apply.
  • Industry awareness: Familiarity with transaction processes, compliance requirements, or closing‑related workflows — whether from title, lending, legal, or similar fields.
  • Certification: Notary public and escrow officer licenses.
  • Industry awareness: Technical knowledge of closing process.
  • Computer skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite.
  • Communications skills: Strong written and verbal skills to keep agents, buyers, sellers, and all other parties up to date with the process and work with them to resolve issues.

What we’d like you to have:

  • One year of direct escrow closing experience.
  • Experience managing high‑volume transactions, deadlines, or multi‑party coordination.
  • A client base or professional network that may follow you to our company (not required).

  • Background in title, mortgage processing, loan origination, real estate coordination, legal assistant work, or similar roles involving contracts and documentation.

  • Paid Time Off to Include Holidays, Vacation Time, and Sick Time

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Controls rodent, bird, and insect activity by replacing used bait with fresh bait in external bait stations in all areas of the farm and recording rodent activity on checklist, removing bird nests and installing barriers to prevent the building of new nests, and applying insecticides as recommended per manufacturer label in office and supply holding area (70%)
  • Run the mower, weedeater, and brush hog as needed to help maintain the farm. (10%)

(10%)

No jewelry may be worn on the jobsite except for medical ID jewelry and body piercings covered by appropriate clothing. Must be willing to sign an agreement to avoid any avian species (chickens, ducks, birds, etc.). Must be willing to sign and abide by the Company Biosecurity and Company Animal Welfare Guidelines.

  • Physical: Must use safe lifting techniques. Must regularly lift and/or move items such as vehicle parts, fan motors, tools weighing up to 50 pounds. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to climb ladders; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; balance; stoop; talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision; distance vision; color vision; peripheral vision; depth perception; and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Tools and Equipment: Requires use of hand tools such as hammer, wire cutters; power tools such as drill, circular saw; safe operation of vehicle to and from work area.
  • Environment: Required to work outdoors in all types of weather and on wet, slippery surfaces.
  • Personal Protective Equipment Required: Safety goggles and/or glasses, face shield, chemical gloves, waterproof apron, and rubber boots are required. Must wear company provided facial covering. Ear plugs will be worn as required by task. NIOSH approved N95 particulate respirators may be worn as desired.
  • Chemicals Commonly Used: Rodenticides, insecticides, disinfectants, vehicle fluids, and lubricants.

title: Senior Space Auditor - Federal Sector - TS/SCI with CI Poly
description:
Procon is a top-ranked construction management and technology consulting firm with 25 years of experience delivering complex projects across the U.S. and worldwide. As an ENR Top 100 CM/PM firm, we provide exceptional opportunities for professionals to grow their careers while supporting critical government and commercial programs.

Procon is seeking a qualified Sr. Space Auditor to support the FLS Space Management Team with maintaining accurate, current, and relevant facility and occupancy data. The Space Auditor will work directly with Directorate and Office Space Coordinators, Site Chiefs, Building Managers, government personnel, and other stakeholders involved in the use, assignment, and allocation of space.

The selected candidate will conduct facility and site audits, validate occupancy and personnel bed-down information, update seating allocations and floor plans, and analyze building usage data to support space planning, utilization, and compliance efforts. This role requires strong attention to detail, customer service skills, technical proficiency with space management tools, and the ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Requirements

Qualifications and Skills

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph.

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Facilities Management, Engineering, Planning, or a related field and 6+ years of experience or 10+ years of experience in lieu of a degree.

  • Experience supporting space management, occupancy planning, facility planning, space auditing, or a related function.

  • Prior experience using ARCHIBUS or a comparable Computer-Aided Facility Management system.

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD and Revit for reviewing, developing, or updating facility floor plans and space layouts.

  • Experience conducting space audits, facility assessments, occupancy validations, or personnel bed-down reviews.

  • Ability to perform field measurements and accurately document facility conditions.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, architectural drawings, and floor plans.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, and Adobe products.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with and prepare materials for senior leadership.

  • Strong customer service and stakeholder coordination skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including periodic overseas travel.

  • Experience with strategic space planning, occupancy planning, facilities planning, and workplace utilization analysis preferred.

  • Familiarity with federal space accountability requirements, including 1450 and 1450-1 accountable spaces preferred.

  • Experience maintaining space inventory, occupancy, and utilization data for large or geographically dispersed facility portfolios preferred.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Support the FLS Space Management Team in maintaining accurate space, occupancy, and utilization data.

  • Coordinate directly with Directorate and Office Space Coordinators, Site Chiefs, Building Managers, and other stakeholders involved in space allocation and facility use.

  • Gather, analyze, and coordinate customer space and occupancy requirements.

  • Conduct facility and site walks to validate existing conditions, seating assignments, occupancy levels, and personnel bed-downs.

  • Perform field measurements and verify room dimensions, layouts, and space configurations.

  • Update floor plans and seating allocations based on audit findings and facility changes.

  • Resolve spatial orientation, floor plan, and occupancy discrepancies within assigned facilities.

  • Develop and revise space layouts using AutoCAD and Revit.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, floor plans, architectural drawings, and facility documentation.

  • Maintain accurate accounting of space usage, capacity, occupancy, and vacancy.

  • Use ARCHIBUS Computer-Aided Facility Management software to update records and generate utilization reports.

  • Pull and analyze capacity, occupancy, vacancy, and utilization data from the ARCHIBUS database.

  • Assist government personnel in identifying and resolving immediate and future space planning and occupancy needs.

  • Support strategic space planning, occupancy planning, and facility planning initiatives.

  • Assist Space Planners in identifying gaps and discrepancies in 1450 and 1450-1 accountable spaces.

  • Assemble and analyze building usage information to support planning, reporting, and compliance processes.

  • Prepare written reports, presentations, and communications for senior leadership.

  • Facilitate internal, public, and stakeholder meetings or workshops when applicable.

  • Manage multiple projects and assignments simultaneously while prioritizing work in accordance with leadership expectations.

  • Perform space audits at facilities worldwide, including domestic and international travel, on a bi-monthly or quarterly basis or more frequently as required by the customer.

Benefits

Salary commensurate with experience.

Interested and qualified candidates please submit a cover letter and a resume.

Procon offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, including full medical/dental insurance and 401(K) plan. Procon is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected factor.

  • 20 procent fremdrift og kundeansvar på mindre projekter

Du er kommerciel, struktureret og god til at skabe tillid.

  • Fleksibilitet, god frokost, ordentligt udstyr og massageordning.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med base på vores kontor på Nørrebro.
Send dit CV og nogle få linjer om, hvorfor du kan udvikle vores kunder og skabe kommercielle resultater sammen med dem.

Vi holder samtaler løbende. Har du spørgsmål, så skriv til joachim@dtails.dk.

title: Product Manager Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on critical financial-market infrastructure, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets and are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that reflects the world we serve.

Pay and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits
  • Pension
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (Onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day of your choosing)

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

The Settlement Product Management Director role is responsible for overseeing and enhancing the safety, resiliency, efficiency, and client experience of DTCC’s day-to-day DTC settlement services (Run the Business / bank ‘pillar). The role provides senior product leadership across the production lifecycle, using data, disciplined governance, strong documentation, and clear accountability to identify emerging risks, manage business impact, and sustain reliable outcomes for clients and the market.

Operating within Equity Clearing & Settlement’s integrated product model, the Director partners closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Client Services, Regulatory Relations, and Finance and in tandem with Product Managers focused on delivery (Deliver the Business) and strategy (Change the Business) pillars. The role serves as a senior subject-matter leader for the DTC settlement lifecycle and translates production insight, client needs, controls, incidents, regulatory obligations, and performance trends into prioritized actions and sustainable product improvements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Settlement product leadership: Provide end-to-end product oversight for DTC settlement services and related capabilities, with a strong understanding of transaction input, processing, settlement completion, intraday activity, cutoffs, end-of-day processing, and downstream dependencies.
  • Production health and service performance: Monitor volumes, service levels, exceptions, client impacts, incidents, recurring defects, and operational trends; use data to expose issues early, establish accountability, and drive timely resolution.
  • Risk, controls, and resiliency: Partner with Operations, Risk, Technology, and control functions to maintain a sound control environment, address findings and vulnerabilities, strengthen recovery and contingency readiness, and support applicable regulatory and resilience obligations.
  • Settlement domain stewardship: Apply knowledge of DTC settlement processing, including settlement controls and liquidity and risk-management mechanisms, to assess business impacts and support safe, efficient market outcomes.
  • Incident and problem management: Act as a senior Product Management lead for significant production events, coordinating impact assessment, stakeholder communication, root-cause follow-through, remediation, and lessons learned.
  • Client and industry experience: Maintain a client-centric perspective across daily service management; engage with clients and internal client-facing teams to understand issues, communicate impacts, and identify opportunities to improve transparency, usability, and service quality.
  • Change intake and prioritization: Convert production insights, client feedback, risk items, regulatory needs, and operational pain points into clearly defined enhancements; partner with Deliver the Business and Change the Business to sequence work and ensure appropriate ownership and execution.
  • Release and operational readiness: Represent Run the Business in release planning, testing, implementation, and readiness reviews; confirm that procedures, controls, communications, training, support models, and escalation paths are complete before production deployment.
  • Governance and management reporting: Prepare clear, data-driven materials for leadership and governance forums, providing transparent views of service health, risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and recommended actions.
  • Financial and capacity management: Contribute to annual planning, budgeting, resource prioritization, vendor oversight, and cost management for the Settlement product portfolio.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Break down silos and align global teams across Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Client Services around shared outcomes.
  • People leadership: Lead, coach, and develop product professionals; set clear expectations, promote accountability and sound judgment, and foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and client focus.

Note: The primary responsibilities of this role are not limited to the activities described above.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 10 years of related experience in product management, securities processing, market infrastructure, financial services operations, or a comparable discipline
  • Bachelor Degree Preferred or equivalent experience.

Talents Needed for Success:

  • Deep understanding of U.S. equity market structure, the end-to-end trade lifecycle, and post-trade clearing and settlement processes.
  • Familiarity with DTC settlement controls and liquidity and risk-management mechanisms, including the Collateral Monitor, Net Debit Cap, Settlement Progress Payments, and related exception-management processes.
  • Working knowledge of settlement transaction flows, intraday and end-of-day processing, controls, cutoffs, participant impacts, exception management, and relevant risk and liquidity mechanisms.
  • Demonstrated experience managing production services in a highly regulated, high-availability environment, including operational risk, controls, resilience, incident response, and root-cause remediation.
  • Strong product-management discipline, including backlog prioritization, requirements definition, release planning, operational readiness, and product lifecycle management and governance, and the interaction among Run the Business, delivery, and longer-term strategic change.
  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and tools such as Jira or comparable product and workflow-management platforms.
  • Executive-level written, verbal communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to create dashboards, business cases, and governance materials that translate complex information and settlement issues, risks, and recommendations into clear and concise decisions and actions.
  • Proven ability to use metrics, trend analysis, and structured problem solving to identify risks, analyze service volumes, performance indicators, assess client and business impacts, and make decisions using reporting, visualization, or business-intelligence tools.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and make sound decisions across Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and client-facing organizations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional and global teams through complex issues, competing priorities, and time-sensitive events.
  • Experience engaging clients, regulators, industry groups, or other market participants on complex operational or settlement topics.

title: Senior Talent Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the team

Zillow’s Talent Intelligence team provides objective external market research and intelligence to inform talent, workforce, and organizational decisions. We serve as internal consultants to executives and leaders, bringing a vital “outside-in” perspective to complex business questions. Our engagements may include talent and skills market analysis, competitive and organizational intelligence, leadership research, location strategy, and emerging workforce trends. By translating external data into clear implications and recommendations, we help Zillow’s leadership make more informed decisions in a distributed, CloudHQ environment.

About the role

As a Senior Talent Intelligence Analyst, you are a strategic research partner to Zillow’s leadership, owning the team’s most complex and highest-visibility engagements. You sit at the intersection of external market intelligence and business strategy, helping leaders frame ambiguous questions, understand relevant market dynamics, and evaluate potential paths forward. You will design and lead a range of research engagements across evolving talent, workforce, and organizational priorities, bringing sound judgment, analytical rigor, and clear recommendations with minimal oversight

You will get to:

  • Lead complex, ambiguous Talent Intelligence engagements from initial scoping through executive delivery, determining the appropriate research approach, data sources, analysis, and outputs for each business question.

  • Build external market intelligence across a range of evolving topics, which may include talent and skills markets, competitive and organizational insights, leadership profiles, location strategy, and broader workforce trends.

  • Use advanced intelligence tools and diverse external sources to identify market patterns, benchmarks, risks, and opportunities relevant to Zillow’s talent and organizational priorities.

  • Conduct competitive and organizational research to help leaders understand how other companies build, structure, scale, and evolve their teams and capabilities.

  • Translate complex quantitative and qualitative research into clear implications, options, and recommendations that support informed decision-making.

  • Synthesize findings into executive-ready narratives, briefings, and visualizations, presenting directly to VPs and senior stakeholders.

  • Act as a strategic thought partner to executives, business leaders, and Talent Acquisition, advising on how external intelligence can inform both near- and long-term priorities.

  • Help evolve the Talent Intelligence function by identifying new use cases, methodologies, data sources, tools, and offerings while mentoring and raising the bar for the broader team.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $109,000.00 - $174,000.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $103,500.00 - $165,300.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You have a “detective” mindset and know how to combine intelligence tools, public information, and sound research judgment to answer ambiguous, high-stakes business and talent questions.

  • You can distill complex research into high-level themes and narratives that resonate with C-suite and executive audiences.

  • You have a high bar for data integrity and are comfortable navigating large, diverse datasets to find clear, actionable insights.

  • You build trust by providing objective, high-quality research that helps leaders solve complex organizational problems.

  • You are an experienced, credible partner to senior stakeholders, able to manage up and negotiate scope without formal authority.

  • You enjoy mentoring and developing the skills of less experienced analysts.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in talent intelligence, market research, management consulting, or a high-level recruitment strategy role, including experience independently owning complex, ambiguous projects end-to-end.

  • Use generative AI, advanced intelligence platforms, and diverse external sources to identify market patterns, benchmarks, risks, and opportunities

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym. Choć jesteśmy zupełnie różni to mamy jeden cel - wszystko robimy na bank. Mamy też możliwość integracji z innymi pracownikami np. dzięki ponad 20 Klubom Zainteresowań.
Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • aktywne pozyskiwanie klientów korporacyjnych z sektora Commercial Real Estate oraz rozwijanie krajowej i międzynarodowej sieci kontaktów biznesowych;
  • identyfikowanie potencjału biznesowego klientów i budowanie długoterminowej strategii współpracy;
  • samodzielna wstępna strukturyzacja transakcji finansowych oraz proponowanie klientom alternatywnych rozwiązań dostarczających wartość biznesową;
  • zarządzanie portfelem klientów korporacyjnych;
  • budowanie i rozwijanie relacji z najwyższą kadrą zarządzającą klientów;
  • inicjowanie i współtworzenie nowych rozwiązań, procesów, produktów i usług zwiększających wartość dla klientów;
  • koordynowanie współpracy pomiędzy wszystkimi uczestnikami procesu transakcyjnego;
  • bieżąca współpraca z jednostkami Ryzyka Kredytowego, Lendingu oraz Zespołem Strukturyzowania Transakcji przy opracowywaniu optymalnych rozwiązań finansowych.

Aplikuj do nas, jeśli:

  • masz doświadczenie w pozyskiwaniu, rozwijaniu i zarządzaniu relacjami z klientami z sektora nieruchomości komercyjnych (CRE);
  • bardzo dobrze znasz polski rynek nieruchomości komercyjnych i jego uczestników;
  • potrafisz budować relacje biznesowe na poziomie zarządów i właścicieli firm;
  • cechują Cię przedsiębiorczość, samodzielność i nastawienie na realizację ambitnych celów biznesowych;
  • chcesz rozwijać się w międzynarodowym środowisku Grupy Erste i współtworzyć ambitne plany rozwoju biznesu w Polsce;
  • bardzo dobrze komunikujesz się w języku angielskim w mowie i piśmie.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę;
  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym;
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego);
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego;
  • kartę Multisport;
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach;
  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku, warsztaty z samoobrony;
  • wyprawkę dla dzieci;
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala;
  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne.


Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?
Na bank nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań. Przez początkowy okres pracy będzie towarzyszył Ci Buddy, który pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania.

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach:
1. Wyślij CV w języku angielskim do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu.
2. Spotkaj się z rekruterem/-ką i managerem/-ką (spotkanie w języku angielskim).
3. Pracuj z nami w naszym zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania.
Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.
